about: Every description, limit, default and unit is PX4's own, generated by PX4 from its source code. A default is the firmware's default: choosing an airframe changes many parameters from it.

ctl_bw.long: Speed controller bandwidth, in Hz. Higher values result in faster speed and current rise times, but may result in overshoot and higher current consumption. For fixed-wing aircraft, this value should be less than 50 Hz; for multirotors, values up to 100 Hz may provide improvements in responsiveness.

ctl_dir.long: Motor spin direction as detected during initial enumeration. Use 0 or 1 to reverse direction.

ctl_gain.long: Determines controller aggressiveness; units are amp-seconds per radian. Systems with higher rotational inertia (large props) will need gain increased; systems with low rotational inertia (small props) may need gain decreased. Higher values result in faster response, but may result in oscillation and excessive overshoot. Lower values result in a slower, smoother response.

esc_index.short: Index of this ESC in throttle command messages.

mot_i_max.long: This determines the maximum current controller setpoint, as well as the maximum allowable current setpoint slew rate. This value should generally be set to the continuous current rating listed in the motor’s specification sheet, or set equal to the motor’s specified continuous power divided by the motor voltage limit.

mot_kv.short: Motor Kv in RPM per volt.
mot_kv.long: This can be taken from the motor’s specification sheet; accuracy will help control performance but some deviation from the specified value is acceptable.

mot_ls.short: READ ONLY: Motor inductance in henries.

mot_num_poles.long: Used to convert mechanical speeds to electrical speeds. This number should be taken from the motor’s specification sheet.

mot_rs.short: READ ONLY: Motor resistance in ohms.
mot_rs.long: This is measured on start-up. When tuning a new motor, check that this value is approximately equal to the value shown in the motor’s specification sheet.

mot_v_max.long: The current controller’s commanded voltage will never exceed this value. Note that this may safely be above the nominal voltage of the motor; to determine the actual motor voltage limit, divide the motor’s rated power by the motor current limit.

gnss.dyn_model.long: Dynamic model used in the GNSS positioning engine. 0 – Automotive, 1 – Sea, 2 – Airborne.

gnss.old_fix_msg.long: Broadcast the old (deprecated) GNSS fix message uavcan.equipment.gnss.Fix alongside the new alternative uavcan.equipment.gnss.Fix2. It is recommended to disable this feature to reduce the CAN bus traffic.

gnss.warn_dimens.long: Set the device health to Warning if the dimensionality of the GNSS solution is less than this value. 3 for the full (3D) solution, 2 for planar (2D) solution, 1 for time-only solution, 0 disables the feature.

gnss.warn_sats.short: Set the device health to Warning if the number of satellites used in the GNSS solution is below this threshold. Zero disables the feature

uavcan.pubp-pres.short: Set the device health to Warning if the number of satellites used in the GNSS solution is below this threshold. Zero disables the feature

ADSB_CALLSIGN_1.long: Sets first 4 characters of a total of 8. Valid characters are A-Z, 0-9, " ". Example "PX4 " -> 1347957792 For CALLSIGN shorter than 8 characters use the null terminator at the end '\0'.

ADSB_CALLSIGN_2.long: Sets second 4 characters of a total of 8. Valid characters are A-Z, 0-9, " " only. Example "TEST" -> 1413829460 For CALLSIGN shorter than 8 characters use the null terminator at the end '\0'.

ADSB_EMIT_TYPE.long: Configure the emitter type of the vehicle.

ADSB_ICAO_ID.long: Defines the ICAO ID of the vehicle

ADSB_ICAO_SPECL.long: This vehicle is always tracked. Use 0 to disable.

ADSB_LEN_WIDTH.long: Report the length and width of the vehicle in meters. In most cases, use '1' for the smallest vehicle size.

ADSB_LIST_MAX.long: Change number of targets to track

ADSB_MAX_SPEED.long: Informs ADSB vehicles of this vehicle's max speed capability

ADSB_SQUAWK.long: This parameter defines the squawk code. Value should be between 0000 and 7777.

PCA9685_DUTY_EN.short: Put the selected channels into Duty-Cycle output mode.
PCA9685_DUTY_EN.long: The driver will output standard pulse-width encoded signal without this bit set. To make PCA9685 output in duty-cycle fashion, please enable the corresponding channel bit here and adjusting standard params to suit your need. The driver will have 12bits resolution for duty-cycle output. That means to achieve 0% to 100% output range on one channel, the corresponding params MIN and MAX for the channel should be set to 0 and 4096. Other standard params follows the same rule.

PCA9685_PWM_FREQ.long: Controls the PWM frequency at timing perspective. This is independent from PWM update frequency, as PCA9685 is capable to output without being continuously commanded by FC. Higher frequency leads to more accurate pulse width, but some ESCs and servos may not support it. This parameter should be set to the same value as PWM update rate in most case. This parameter MUST NOT exceed upper limit of 400.0, if any outputs as generic 1000~2000us pulse width is desired. Frequency higher than 400 only makes sense in duty-cycle mode.

PCA9685_REV.short: Reverse Output Range for PCA9685 Output.
PCA9685_REV.long: Allows to reverse the output range for each channel. Note: this is only useful for servos.

PCA9685_SCHD_HZ.long: Controls the update rate of PWM output. Flight Controller will inform those numbers of update events in a second, to PCA9685. Higher update rate will consume more I2C bandwidth, which may even lead to worse output latency, or completely block I2C bus.

ASPD_BETA_GATE.short: Gate size for sideslip angle fusion.
ASPD_BETA_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

ASPD_BETA_NOISE.long: Sideslip measurement noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_DO_CHECKS.long: Controls which checks are run to check airspeed data for validity. Only applied if ASPD_PRIMARY > 0.

bits.0: Only data missing check (triggers if more than 1s no data)
bits.1: Data stuck (triggers if data is exactly constant for 2s in FW mode)
bits.3: Load factor check (triggers if measurement is below stall speed)
bits.4: First principle check (airspeed change vs. throttle and pitch)

ASPD_FALLBACK_GW.short: Enable fallback to sensor-less airspeed estimation.
ASPD_FALLBACK_GW.long: If set to true and airspeed checks are enabled, it will use a sensor-less airspeed estimation based on groundspeed minus windspeed if no other airspeed sensor available to fall back to.

ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.short: First principle airspeed check time window.
ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.long: Window for comparing airspeed change to throttle and pitch change. Triggers when the airspeed change within this window is negative while throttle increases and the vehicle pitches down. Is meant to catch degrading airspeed blockages as can happen when flying through icing conditions. Relies on FW_THR_TRIM being set accurately.

ASPD_FS_INNOV.long: This specifies the minimum airspeed innovation required to trigger a failsafe. Larger values make the check less sensitive, smaller values make it more sensitive. Large innovations indicate an inconsistency between predicted (groundspeed - windspeeed) and measured airspeed. The time required to detect a fault when the threshold is exceeded depends on the size of the exceedance and is controlled by the ASPD_FS_INTEG parameter.

ASPD_FS_INTEG.long: This sets the time integral of airspeed innovation exceedance above ASPD_FS_INNOV required to trigger a failsafe. Larger values make the check less sensitive, smaller positive values make it more sensitive.

ASPD_FS_T_START.long: Delay before switching back to using airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is good. Set to a negative value to disable the re-enabling in flight.

ASPD_FS_T_STOP.long: Delay before stopping use of airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is bad.

ASPD_PRIMARY.short: Index or primary airspeed measurement source.

ASPD_SCALE_1.long: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the first airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_2.long: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the second airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_3.long: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the third airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_APPLY.short: Controls when to apply the new estimated airspeed scale(s).

values.0: Do not automatically apply the estimated scale
values.1: Apply the estimated scale after disarm
values.2: Apply the estimated scale in air

ASPD_SCALE_NSD.short: Wind estimator true airspeed scale process noise spectral density.
ASPD_SCALE_NSD.long: Airspeed scale process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector. When unaided, the scale uncertainty (1-sigma, unitless) increases by this amount every second.

ASPD_TAS_GATE.short: Gate size for true airspeed fusion.
ASPD_TAS_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

ASPD_TAS_NOISE.short: Wind estimator true airspeed measurement noise.
ASPD_TAS_NOISE.long: True airspeed measurement noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_WERR_THR.short: Horizontal wind uncertainty threshold for synthetic airspeed.
ASPD_WERR_THR.long: The synthetic airspeed estimate (from groundspeed and heading) will be declared valid as soon and as long the horizontal wind uncertainty is below this value.

ASPD_WIND_NSD.short: Wind estimator wind process noise spectral density.
ASPD_WIND_NSD.long: Wind process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector. When unaided, the wind estimate uncertainty (1-sigma, in m/s) increases by this amount every second.

ATT_ACC_COMP.short: Acceleration compensation based on GPS velocity.

ATT_EN.long: Enable standalone quaternion based attitude estimator.

ATT_EXT_HDG_M.short: External heading usage mode (from Motion capture/Vision).
ATT_EXT_HDG_M.long: Set to 1 to use heading estimate from vision. Set to 2 to use heading from motion capture.

ATT_MAG_DECL.long: This parameter is not used in normal operation, as the declination is looked up based on the GPS coordinates of the vehicle.

ATT_W_MAG.long: Set to 0 to avoid using the magnetometer.

FW_AT_APPLY.short: Controls when to apply the new gains.
FW_AT_APPLY.long: After the auto-tuning sequence is completed, a new set of gains is available and can be applied immediately or after landing.

values.0: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
values.1: Apply the new gains after disarm
values.2: Apply the new gains in air

FW_AT_AXES.long: Defines which axes will be tuned during the auto-tuning sequence Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Roll 1 : Pitch 2 : Yaw

FW_AT_MAN_AUX.short: Enable/disable auto tuning using an RC AUX input.
FW_AT_MAN_AUX.long: Defines which RC_MAP_AUXn parameter maps the RC channel used to enable/disable auto tuning.

FW_AT_START.long: WARNING: this will inject steps to the rate controller and can be dangerous. Only activate if you know what you are doing, and in a safe environment. Any motion of the remote stick will abort the signal injection and reset this parameter Best is to perform the identification in position or hold mode. Increase the amplitude of the injected signal using FW_AT_SYSID_AMP for more signal/noise ratio

FW_AT_SYSID_AMP.long: This parameter scales the signal sent to the rate controller during system identification.

FW_AT_SYSID_F0.short: Start frequency of the injected signal.
FW_AT_SYSID_F0.long: Can be set lower or higher than the end frequency

FW_AT_SYSID_F1.short: End frequency of the injected signal.
FW_AT_SYSID_F1.long: Can be set lower or higher than the start frequency

FW_AT_SYSID_TIME.long: Duration of the input signal sent on each axis during system identification

FW_AT_SYSID_TYPE.long: Type of signal used during system identification to excite the system.

MC_AT_APPLY.short: Controls when to apply the new gains.
MC_AT_APPLY.long: After the auto-tuning sequence is completed, a new set of gains is available and can be applied immediately or after landing. WARNING Applying the gains in air is dangerous as there is no guarantee that those new gains will be able to stabilize the drone properly.

values.0: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
values.1: Apply the new gains after disarm
values.2: WARNING Apply the new gains in air

MC_AT_RISE_TIME.short: Desired angular rate closed-loop rise time.

MC_AT_START.long: WARNING: this will inject steps to the rate controller and can be dangerous. Only activate if you know what you are doing, and in a safe environment. Any motion of the remote stick will abort the signal injection and reset this parameter Best is to perform the identification in position or hold mode. Increase the amplitude of the injected signal using MC_AT_SYSID_AMP for more signal/noise ratio

BAT1_A_PER_V.long: The voltage seen by the ADC multiplied by this factor will determine the battery current. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_CAPACITY.long: Defines the capacity of battery 1 in mAh.

BAT1_I_CHANNEL.long: This parameter specifies the ADC channel used to monitor current of main power battery. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_I_OVERWRITE.long: This parameter allows to overwrite the current measured during idle (unarmed) state with a user-defined constant value (expressed in amperes). When the system is armed, the measured current is used. This is useful because on certain ESCs current measurements are inaccurate in case of no load. Negative values are ignored and will cause the measured current to be used. The default value of 0 disables the overwrite, in which case the measured value is always used.

BAT1_N_CELLS.long: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT1_R_INTERNAL.short: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 1.
BAT1_R_INTERNAL.long: If non-negative, then this will be used instead of the online estimated internal resistance.

BAT1_SOURCE.long: This parameter controls the source of battery data. The value 'Power Module' means that measurements are expected to come from a power module. If the value is set to 'External' then the system expects to receive mavlink battery status messages. If the value is set to 'ESCs', the battery information are taken from the esc_status message. This requires the ESC to provide both voltage as well as current.

BAT1_V_CHANNEL.long: This parameter specifies the ADC channel used to monitor voltage of main power battery. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_V_CHARGED.long: Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered full. For a more accurate estimate set this below the nominal voltage of e.g. 4.2V

BAT1_V_DIV.long: This is the divider from battery 1 voltage to ADC voltage. If using e.g. Mauch power modules the value from the datasheet can be applied straight here. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT1_V_EMPTY.long: Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered empty. The voltage should be chosen above the steep dropoff at 3.5V. A typical lithium battery can only be discharged under high load down to 10% before it drops off to a voltage level damaging the cells.

BAT2_A_PER_V.long: The voltage seen by the ADC multiplied by this factor will determine the battery current. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT2_CAPACITY.long: Defines the capacity of battery 2 in mAh.

BAT2_I_CHANNEL.long: This parameter specifies the ADC channel used to monitor current of main power battery. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT2_I_OVERWRITE.long: This parameter allows to overwrite the current measured during idle (unarmed) state with a user-defined constant value (expressed in amperes). When the system is armed, the measured current is used. This is useful because on certain ESCs current measurements are inaccurate in case of no load. Negative values are ignored and will cause the measured current to be used. The default value of 0 disables the overwrite, in which case the measured value is always used.

BAT2_N_CELLS.long: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT2_R_INTERNAL.short: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 2.
BAT2_R_INTERNAL.long: If non-negative, then this will be used instead of the online estimated internal resistance.

BAT2_SOURCE.long: This parameter controls the source of battery data. The value 'Power Module' means that measurements are expected to come from a power module. If the value is set to 'External' then the system expects to receive mavlink battery status messages. If the value is set to 'ESCs', the battery information are taken from the esc_status message. This requires the ESC to provide both voltage as well as current.

BAT2_V_CHANNEL.long: This parameter specifies the ADC channel used to monitor voltage of main power battery. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT2_V_CHARGED.long: Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered full. For a more accurate estimate set this below the nominal voltage of e.g. 4.2V

BAT2_V_DIV.long: This is the divider from battery 2 voltage to ADC voltage. If using e.g. Mauch power modules the value from the datasheet can be applied straight here. A value of -1 means to use the board default.

BAT2_V_EMPTY.long: Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered empty. The voltage should be chosen above the steep dropoff at 3.5V. A typical lithium battery can only be discharged under high load down to 10% before it drops off to a voltage level damaging the cells.

BAT3_CAPACITY.long: Defines the capacity of battery 3 in mAh.

BAT3_N_CELLS.long: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT3_R_INTERNAL.short: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 3.
BAT3_R_INTERNAL.long: If non-negative, then this will be used instead of the online estimated internal resistance.

BAT3_SOURCE.long: This parameter controls the source of battery data. The value 'Power Module' means that measurements are expected to come from a power module. If the value is set to 'External' then the system expects to receive mavlink battery status messages. If the value is set to 'ESCs', the battery information are taken from the esc_status message. This requires the ESC to provide both voltage as well as current.

BAT3_V_CHARGED.long: Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered full. For a more accurate estimate set this below the nominal voltage of e.g. 4.2V

BAT3_V_EMPTY.long: Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered empty. The voltage should be chosen above the steep dropoff at 3.5V. A typical lithium battery can only be discharged under high load down to 10% before it drops off to a voltage level damaging the cells.

BAT_ADC_CHANNEL.short: This parameter is deprecated. Please use BAT1_I_CHANNEL.

BAT_AVRG_CURRENT.long: This value is used to initialize the in-flight average current estimation, which in turn is used for estimating remaining flight time and RTL triggering.

BAT_CRIT_THR.long: Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as critically low. This has to be lower than the low threshold. This threshold commonly will trigger RTL.

BAT_EMERGEN_THR.long: Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as dangerously low. This has to be lower than the critical threshold. This threshold commonly will trigger landing.

BAT_LOW_THR.long: Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as low. This has to be higher than the critical threshold.

BAT_V_OFFS_CURR.short: Offset in volt as seen by the ADC input of the current sensor.
BAT_V_OFFS_CURR.long: This offset will be subtracted before calculating the battery current based on the voltage.

CAM_CAP_DELAY.long: This parameter sets the delay between image integration start and strobe firing

values.1: Get timestamp of mid exposure (active high)
values.2: Get timestamp of mid exposure (active low)

TRIG_ACT_TIME.long: This parameter sets the time the trigger needs to pulled high or low.

TRIG_DISTANCE.long: Sets the distance at which to trigger the camera.

TRIG_INTERVAL.long: This parameter sets the time between two consecutive trigger events

TRIG_MIN_INTERVA.long: This parameter sets the minimum time between two consecutive trigger events the specific camera setup is supporting.

TRIG_POLARITY.long: This parameter sets the polarity of the trigger (0 = active low, 1 = active high )

TRIG_PWM_NEUTRAL.short: PWM neutral output on trigger pin.

CBRK_BUZZER.long: Setting this parameter to 782097 will disable the buzzer audio notification. Setting this parameter to 782090 will disable the startup tune, while keeping all others enabled.

CBRK_FLIGHTTERM.long: Setting this parameter to 121212 will disable the flight termination action if triggered by the FailureDetector logic or if FMU is lost. This circuit breaker does not affect the RC loss, data link loss, geofence, and takeoff failure detection safety logic.

CBRK_IO_SAFETY.long: Setting this parameter to 22027 will disable IO safety. WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK.short: Circuit breaker for power supply check.
CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK.long: Setting this parameter to 894281 will disable the power valid checks in the commander. WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_USB_CHK.short: Circuit breaker for USB link check.
CBRK_USB_CHK.long: Setting this parameter to 197848 will disable the USB connected checks in the commander, setting it to 0 keeps them enabled (recommended). We are generally recommending to not fly with the USB link connected and production vehicles should set this parameter to zero to prevent users from flying USB powered. However, for R&D purposes it has proven over the years to work just fine.

CBRK_VTOLARMING.short: Circuit breaker for arming in fixed-wing mode check.
CBRK_VTOLARMING.long: Setting this parameter to 159753 will enable arming in fixed-wing mode for VTOLs. WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT.short: Set the actuator failure failsafe mode.
COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT.long: Note: actuator failure needs to be enabled and configured via FD_ACT_* parameters.

COM_ARMABLE.long: Set 0 to prevent accidental use of the vehicle e.g. for safety or maintenance reasons.

COM_ARM_AUTH_ID.long: Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_AUTH_MET.long: Methods: - one arm: request authorization and arm when authorization is received - two step arm: 1st arm command request an authorization and 2nd arm command arm the drone if authorized Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.long: By default off. The default allows to arm the vehicle without a arm authorization.

COM_ARM_AUTH_TO.long: Timeout for authorizer answer. Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_BAT_MIN.long: Threshold for battery percentage below arming is prohibited. A negative value means BAT_CRIT_THR is the threshold.

COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS.short: Enable checks on ESCs that report telemetry.
COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS.long: If this parameter is set, the system will check ESC's online status and failures. This param is specific for ESCs reporting status. It shall be used only if ESCs support telemetry.

COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK.short: Enable FMU SD card hardfault detection check.
COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK.long: This check detects if there are hardfault files present on the SD card. If so, and the parameter is enabled, arming is prevented.

COM_ARM_IMU_ACC.short: Maximum accelerometer inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming.

COM_ARM_IMU_GYR.short: Maximum rate gyro inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming.

COM_ARM_MAG_ANG.short: Maximum magnetic field inconsistency between units that will allow arming.

COM_ARM_MAG_STR.long: Check if the estimator detects a strong magnetic disturbance (check enabled by EKF2_MAG_CHECK)

COM_ARM_MIS_REQ.long: The default allows to arm the vehicle without a valid mission.

COM_ARM_ODID.short: Enable Drone ID system detection and health check.
COM_ARM_ODID.long: This check detects if the Open Drone ID system is missing. Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be disabled, warn only or deny arming.

values.2: Enforce Open Drone ID system presence

COM_ARM_SDCARD.short: Enable FMU SD card detection check.
COM_ARM_SDCARD.long: This check detects if the FMU SD card is missing. Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be disabled, warn only or deny arming.

COM_ARM_SWISBTN.short: Arm switch is a momentary button.
COM_ARM_SWISBTN.long: 0: Arming/disarming triggers on switch transition. 1: Arming/disarming triggers when holding the momentary button down for COM_RC_ARM_HYST like the stick gesture.

COM_ARM_WO_GPS.long: Measures taken when a check defined by EKF2_GPS_CHECK is failing.

COM_CPU_MAX.short: Maximum allowed CPU load to still arm.
COM_CPU_MAX.long: The check fails if the CPU load is above this threshold for 2s. A negative value disables the check.

COM_DISARM_LAND.short: Time-out for auto disarm after landing.
COM_DISARM_LAND.long: A non-zero, positive value specifies the time-out period in seconds after which the vehicle will be automatically disarmed in case a landing situation has been detected during this period. A zero or negative value means that automatic disarming triggered by landing detection is disabled.

COM_DISARM_MAN.short: Allow disarming via switch/stick/button on multicopters in manual thrust modes.
COM_DISARM_MAN.long: 0: Disallow disarming when not landed 1: Allow disarming in multicopter flight in modes where the thrust is directly controlled by thr throttle stick e.g. Stabilized, Acro

COM_DISARM_PRFLT.short: Time-out for auto disarm if not taking off.
COM_DISARM_PRFLT.long: A non-zero, positive value specifies the time in seconds, within which the vehicle is expected to take off after arming. In case the vehicle didn't takeoff within the timeout it disarms again. A negative value disables autmoatic disarming triggered by a pre-takeoff timeout.

COM_DL_LOSS_T.long: After this amount of seconds without datalink, the GCS connection lost mode triggers

COM_FAIL_ACT_T.short: Delay between failsafe condition triggered and failsafe reaction.
COM_FAIL_ACT_T.long: Before entering failsafe (RTL, Land, Hold), wait COM_FAIL_ACT_T seconds in Hold mode for the user to realize. During that time the user cannot take over control via the stick override feature (see COM_RC_OVERRIDE). Afterwards the configured failsafe action is triggered and the user may use stick override. A zero value disables the delay and the user cannot take over via stick movements (switching modes is still allowed).

COM_FLIGHT_UUID.long: This number is incremented automatically after every flight on disarming in order to remember the next flight UUID. The first flight is 0.

COM_FLTMODE1.long: If the main switch channel is in this range the selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE2.long: If the main switch channel is in this range the selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE3.long: If the main switch channel is in this range the selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE4.long: If the main switch channel is in this range the selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE5.long: If the main switch channel is in this range the selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE6.long: If the main switch channel is in this range the selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTT_LOW_ACT.long: Action the system takes when the remaining flight time is below the estimated time it takes to reach the RTL destination.

COM_FLT_PROFILE.long: Describes the intended use of the vehicle. Can be used by ground control software or log post processing. This param does not influence the behavior within the firmware. This means for example the control logic is independent of the setting of this param (but depends on other params).

COM_FLT_TIME_MAX.long: The vehicle aborts the current operation and returns to launch when the time since takeoff is above this value. It is not possible to resume the mission or switch to any auto mode other than RTL or Land. Taking over in any manual mode is still possible. Starting from 90% of the maximum flight time, a warning message will be sent every 1 minute with the remaining time until automatic RTL. Set to -1 to disable.

COM_FORCE_SAFETY.long: Force safety when the vehicle disarms

COM_HLDL_LOSS_T.short: High Latency Datalink loss time threshold.
COM_HLDL_LOSS_T.long: After this amount of seconds without datalink the data link lost mode triggers

COM_HLDL_REG_T.short: High Latency Datalink regain time threshold.
COM_HLDL_REG_T.long: After a data link loss: after this number of seconds with a healthy datalink the 'datalink loss' flag is set back to false

COM_HOME_EN.long: Set home position automatically if possible.

COM_HOME_IN_AIR.short: Allows setting the home position after takeoff.
COM_HOME_IN_AIR.long: If set to true, the autopilot is allowed to set its home position after takeoff The true home position is back-computed if a local position is estimate if available. If no local position is available, home is set to the current position.

COM_IMB_PROP_ACT.long: Action the system takes when an imbalanced propeller is detected by the failure detector. See also FD_IMB_PROP_THR to set the failure threshold.

COM_KILL_DISARM.short: Timeout value for disarming when kill switch is engaged.

COM_LKDOWN_TKO.short: Timeout for detecting a failure after takeoff.
COM_LKDOWN_TKO.long: A non-zero, positive value specifies the timeframe in seconds within failure detector is allowed to disarm the vehicle if attitude exceeds the limits defined in FD_FAIL_P and FD_FAIL_R. The check is not executed for flight modes that do support acrobatic maneuvers, e.g: Acro (MC/FW) and Manual (FW). A zero or negative value means that the check is disabled.

COM_LOW_BAT_ACT.long: Action the system takes at critical battery. See also BAT_CRIT_THR and BAT_EMERGEN_THR for definition of battery states.

values.3: Return at critical level, land at emergency level

COM_MODE0_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE1_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE2_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE3_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE4_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE5_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE6_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE7_HASH.long: This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order, which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE_ARM_CHK.short: Allow external mode registration while armed.
COM_MODE_ARM_CHK.long: By default disabled for safety reasons

COM_MOT_TEST_EN.long: If set, enables the actuator test interface via MAVLink (ACTUATOR_TEST), that allows spinning the motors and moving the servos for testing purposes.

COM_OBC_LOSS_T.short: Time-out to wait when onboard computer connection is lost before warning about loss connection.

COM_OBL_RC_ACT.long: The offboard loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout, set by COM_OF_LOSS_T in seconds.

COM_OF_LOSS_T.short: Time-out to wait when offboard connection is lost before triggering offboard lost action.

COM_PARACHUTE.short: Expect and require a healthy MAVLink parachute system.

COM_POSCTL_NAVL.long: This sets the flight mode that will be used if navigation accuracy is no longer adequate for position control in manual Position mode.

COM_POS_FS_EPH.long: This is the horizontal position error (EPH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe. The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing. If the previous position error was below this threshold, there is an additional factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation). Set to -1 to disable.

COM_POS_LOW_ACT.long: Action the system takes when the estimated position has an accuracy below the specified threshold. See COM_POS_LOW_EPH to set the failsafe threshold. The failsafe action is only executed if the vehicle is in auto mission or auto loiter mode, otherwise it is only a warning.

COM_POS_LOW_EPH.long: This triggers the action specified in COM_POS_LOW_ACT if the estimated position accuracy is below this threshold. Local position has to be still declared valid, which requires some kind of velocity aiding or large dead-reckoning time (EKF2_NOAID_TOUT), and a high failsafe threshold (COM_POS_FS_EPH). Set to -1 to disable.

COM_POWER_COUNT.short: Required number of redundant power modules.
COM_POWER_COUNT.long: This configures a check to verify the expected number of 5V rail power supplies are present. By default only one is expected. Note: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK disables all power checks including this one.

COM_PREARM_MODE.long: Condition to enter the prearmed state, an intermediate state between disarmed and armed in which non-throttling actuators are active.

COM_RAM_MAX.short: Maximum allowed RAM usage to pass checks.
COM_RAM_MAX.long: The check fails if the RAM usage is above this threshold. A negative value disables the check.

COM_RCL_EXCEPT.long: Specify modes in which RC loss is ignored and the failsafe action not triggered.

COM_RC_ARM_HYST.long: The default value of 1000 requires the stick to be held in the arm or disarm position for 1 second.

COM_RC_IN_MODE.long: A value of 0 enables RC transmitter control (only). A valid RC transmitter calibration is required. A value of 1 allows joystick control only. RC input handling and the associated checks are disabled. A value of 2 allows either RC Transmitter or Joystick input. The first valid input is used, will fallback to other sources if the input stream becomes invalid. A value of 3 allows either input from RC or joystick. The first available source is selected and used until reboot. A value of 4 ignores any stick input.

COM_RC_LOSS_T.long: The time in seconds without a new setpoint from RC or Joystick, after which the connection is considered lost. This must be kept short as the vehicle will use the last supplied setpoint until the timeout triggers.

COM_RC_OVERRIDE.short: Enable RC stick override of auto and/or offboard modes.
COM_RC_OVERRIDE.long: When RC stick override is enabled, moving the RC sticks more than COM_RC_STICK_OV immediately gives control back to the pilot by switching to Position mode and if position is unavailable Altitude mode. Note: Only has an effect on multicopters, and VTOLs in multicopter mode.

bits.0: Enable override during auto modes (except for in critical battery reaction)

COM_RC_STICK_OV.long: If COM_RC_OVERRIDE is enabled and the joystick input is moved more than this threshold the autopilot the pilot takes over control.

COM_SPOOLUP_TIME.short: Enforced delay between arming and further navigation.
COM_SPOOLUP_TIME.long: The minimal time from arming the motors until moving the vehicle is possible is COM_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds. Goal: - Motors and propellers spool up to idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster - Timeout for ESCs and smart batteries to successfulyy do failure checks e.g. for stuck rotors before the vehicle is off the ground

COM_TAKEOFF_ACT.short: Action after TAKEOFF has been accepted.
COM_TAKEOFF_ACT.long: The mode transition after TAKEOFF has completed successfully.

COM_THROW_EN.long: Allows to start the vehicle by throwing it into the air.

COM_THROW_SPEED.short: Minimum speed for the throw start.
COM_THROW_SPEED.long: When the throw launch is enabled, the drone will only allow motors to spin after this speed is exceeded before detecting the freefall. This is a safety feature to ensure the drone does not turn on after accidental drop or a rapid movement before the throw. Set to 0 to disable.

COM_VEL_FS_EVH.long: This is the horizontal velocity error (EVH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe. The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing. If the previous velocity error was below this threshold, there is an additional factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).

COM_WIND_MAX.long: Wind speed threshold above which an automatic failsafe action is triggered. Failsafe action can be specified with COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.

COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.long: Action the system takes when a wind speed above the specified threshold is detected. See COM_WIND_MAX to set the failsafe threshold. If enabled, it is not possible to resume the mission or switch to any auto mode other than RTL or Land if this threshold is exceeded. Taking over in any manual mode is still possible.

COM_WIND_WARN.long: A warning is triggered if the currently estimated wind speed is above this value. Warning is sent periodically (every 1 minute). Set to -1 to disable.

NAV_DLL_ACT.short: Set GCS connection loss failsafe mode.
NAV_DLL_ACT.long: The GCS connection loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout, set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected action will be executed.

NAV_RCL_ACT.long: The RC loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout, set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds. If RC input checks have been disabled by setting the COM_RC_IN_MODE param it will not be triggered.

CYPHAL_ID.long: Read the specs at http://uavcan.org to learn more about Node ID.

UCAN1_ACTR_PUB.short: actuator_outputs uORB over Cyphal publication port ID.

UCAN1_BMS_BP_SUB.short: UDRAL battery parameters subscription port ID.

UCAN1_BMS_BS_SUB.short: UDRAL battery status subscription port ID.

UCAN1_BMS_ES_SUB.short: UDRAL battery energy source subscription port ID.

UCAN1_FB0_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 0 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_FB1_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 1 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_FB2_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 2 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_FB3_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 3 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_FB4_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 4 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_FB5_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 5 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_FB6_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 6 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_FB7_SUB.short: Cyphal ESC 7 zubax feedback port ID.

UCAN1_UORB_GPS.short: sensor_gps uORB over Cyphal subscription port ID.

UCAN1_UORB_GPS_P.short: sensor_gps uORB over Cyphal publication port ID.

DSHOT_3D_DEAD_H.long: When the actuator_output is between DSHOT_3D_DEAD_L and DSHOT_3D_DEAD_H, motor will not spin. This value is with respect to the mixer_module range (0-1999), not the DSHOT values.

DSHOT_3D_DEAD_L.long: When the actuator_output is between DSHOT_3D_DEAD_L and DSHOT_3D_DEAD_H, motor will not spin. This value is with respect to the mixer_module range (0-1999), not the DSHOT values.

DSHOT_3D_ENABLE.short: Allows for 3d mode when using DShot and suitable mixer.
DSHOT_3D_ENABLE.long: WARNING: ESC must be configured for 3D mode, and DSHOT_MIN set to 0. This splits the throttle ranges in two. Direction 1) 48 is the slowest, 1047 is the fastest. Direction 2) 1049 is the slowest, 2047 is the fastest. When mixer outputs 1000 or value inside DSHOT 3D deadband, DShot 0 is sent.

DSHOT_BIDIR_EN.long: This parameter enables bidirectional DShot which provides RPM feedback. Note that this requires ESCs that support bidirectional DSHot, e.g. BlHeli32. This is not the same as DShot telemetry which requires an additional serial connection.

DSHOT_MIN.long: Minimum Output Value for DShot in percent. The value depends on the ESC. Make sure to set this high enough so that the motors are always spinning while armed.

DSHOT_TEL_CFG.long: Configure on which serial port to run DShot Driver.

MOT_POLE_COUNT.short: Number of magnetic poles of the motors.
MOT_POLE_COUNT.long: Specify the number of magnetic poles of the motors. It is required to compute the RPM value from the eRPM returned with the ESC telemetry. Either get the number from the motor spec sheet or count the magnets on the bell of the motor (not the stator magnets). Typical motors for 5 inch props have 14 poles.

EKF2_ABL_ACCLIM.short: Maximum IMU accel magnitude that allows IMU bias learning.
EKF2_ABL_ACCLIM.long: If the magnitude of the IMU accelerometer vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of high manoeuvre accelerations and IMU nonlinerity and scale factor errors on the accel bias estimates.

EKF2_ABL_GYRLIM.short: Maximum IMU gyro angular rate magnitude that allows IMU bias learning.
EKF2_ABL_GYRLIM.long: If the magnitude of the IMU angular rate vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of rapid rotation rates and associated errors on the accel bias estimates.

EKF2_ABL_LIM.long: The ekf accel bias states will be limited to within a range equivalent to +- of this value.

EKF2_ABL_TAU.short: Accel bias learning inhibit time constant.
EKF2_ABL_TAU.long: The vector magnitude of angular rate and acceleration used to check if learning should be inhibited has a peak hold filter applied to it with an exponential decay. This parameter controls the time constant of the decay.

EKF2_ACC_B_NOISE.short: Process noise for IMU accelerometer bias prediction.

EKF2_AGP_CTRL.long: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Horizontal position fusion 1 : Vertical position fusion

EKF2_AGP_DELAY.short: Aux global position estimator delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_AGP_GATE.short: Gate size for aux global position fusion.
EKF2_AGP_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_AGP_NOISE.short: Measurement noise for aux global position measurements.
EKF2_AGP_NOISE.long: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_ANGERR_INIT.short: 1-sigma tilt angle uncertainty after gravity vector alignment.

EKF2_ARSP_THR.long: Airspeed data is fused for wind estimation if above this threshold. Set to 0 to disable airspeed fusion. For reliable wind estimation both sideslip (see EKF2_FUSE_BETA) and airspeed fusion should be enabled. Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles (or VTOLs in fixed-wing mode).

EKF2_ASPD_MAX.short: Maximum airspeed used for baro static pressure compensation.

EKF2_ASP_DELAY.short: Airspeed measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_AVEL_DELAY.short: Auxiliary Velocity Estimate delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_BARO_CTRL.long: If this parameter is enabled then the estimator will make use of the barometric height measurements to estimate its height in addition to other height sources (if activated).

EKF2_BARO_DELAY.short: Barometer measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_BARO_GATE.short: Gate size for barometric and GPS height fusion.
EKF2_BARO_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_BCOEF_X.short: X-axis ballistic coefficient used for multi-rotor wind estimation.
EKF2_BCOEF_X.long: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by bluff body drag along the forward/reverse axis when flying a multi-copter which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed squared. The predicted drag from the rotors is specified separately by the EKF2_MCOEF parameter. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the bluff body drag model for this axis.

EKF2_BCOEF_Y.short: Y-axis ballistic coefficient used for multi-rotor wind estimation.
EKF2_BCOEF_Y.long: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by bluff body drag along the right/left axis when flying a multi-copter, which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed squared. The predicted drag from the rotors is specified separately by the EKF2_MCOEF parameter. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the bluff body drag model for this axis.

EKF2_BETA_GATE.short: Gate size for synthetic sideslip fusion.
EKF2_BETA_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_DECL_TYPE.short: Integer bitmask controlling handling of magnetic declination.
EKF2_DECL_TYPE.long: Set bits in the following positions to enable functions. 0 : Set to true to use the declination from the geo_lookup library when the GPS position becomes available, set to false to always use the EKF2_MAG_DECL value. 1 : Set to true to save the EKF2_MAG_DECL parameter to the value returned by the EKF when the vehicle disarms.

EKF2_DELAY_MAX.short: Maximum delay of all the aiding sensors.
EKF2_DELAY_MAX.long: Defines the delay between the current time and the delayed-time horizon. This value should be at least as large as the largest EKF2_XXX_DELAY parameter.

EKF2_DRAG_CTRL.long: Activate wind speed estimation using specific-force measurements and a drag model defined by EKF2_BCOEF_[XY] and EKF2_MCOEF. Only use on vehicles that have their thrust aligned with the Z axis and no thrust in the XY plane.

EKF2_DRAG_NOISE.short: Specific drag force observation noise variance.
EKF2_DRAG_NOISE.long: Used by the multi-rotor specific drag force model. Increasing this makes the multi-rotor wind estimates adjust more slowly.

EKF2_EVA_NOISE.short: Measurement noise for vision angle measurements.
EKF2_EVA_NOISE.long: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_EVP_GATE.short: Gate size for vision position fusion.
EKF2_EVP_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_EVP_NOISE.short: Measurement noise for vision position measurements.
EKF2_EVP_NOISE.long: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_EVV_GATE.short: Gate size for vision velocity estimate fusion.
EKF2_EVV_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_EVV_NOISE.short: Measurement noise for vision velocity measurements.
EKF2_EVV_NOISE.long: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_EV_CTRL.long: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Horizontal position fusion 1 : Vertical position fusion 2 : 3D velocity fusion 3 : Yaw

EKF2_EV_DELAY.short: Vision Position Estimator delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_EV_NOISE_MD.long: If set to 0 (default) the measurement noise is taken from the vision message and the EV noise parameters are used as a lower bound. If set to 1 the observation noise is set from the parameters directly,

EKF2_EV_POS_X.short: X position of VI sensor focal point in body frame.
EKF2_EV_POS_X.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_EV_POS_Y.short: Y position of VI sensor focal point in body frame.
EKF2_EV_POS_Y.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_EV_POS_Z.short: Z position of VI sensor focal point in body frame.
EKF2_EV_POS_Z.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_EV_QMIN.long: External vision will only be started and fused if the quality metric is above this threshold. The quality metric is a completely optional field provided by some VIO systems.

EKF2_FUSE_BETA.long: For reliable wind estimation both sideslip and airspeed fusion (see EKF2_ARSP_THR) should be enabled. Only applies to vehicles in fixed-wing mode or with airspeed fusion active. Note: side slip fusion is currently not supported for tailsitters.

EKF2_GND_EFF_DZ.short: Baro deadzone range for height fusion.
EKF2_GND_EFF_DZ.long: Sets the value of deadzone applied to negative baro innovations. Deadzone is enabled when EKF2_GND_EFF_DZ > 0.

EKF2_GND_MAX_HGT.short: Height above ground level for ground effect zone.
EKF2_GND_MAX_HGT.long: Sets the maximum distance to the ground level where negative baro innovations are expected.

EKF2_GPS_CHECK.long: Each threshold value is defined by the parameter indicated next to the check. Drift and offset checks only run when the vehicle is on ground and stationary.

EKF2_GPS_CTRL.long: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Longitude and latitude fusion 1 : Altitude fusion 2 : 3D velocity fusion 3 : Dual antenna heading fusion

EKF2_GPS_DELAY.short: GPS measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_GPS_POS_X.short: X position of GPS antenna in body frame.
EKF2_GPS_POS_X.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_GPS_POS_Y.short: Y position of GPS antenna in body frame.
EKF2_GPS_POS_Y.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_GPS_POS_Z.short: Z position of GPS antenna in body frame.
EKF2_GPS_POS_Z.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_GPS_P_GATE.short: Gate size for GNSS position fusion.
EKF2_GPS_P_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_GPS_V_GATE.short: Gate size for GNSS velocity fusion.
EKF2_GPS_V_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_GPS_YAW_OFF.short: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS.

EKF2_GRAV_NOISE.short: Accelerometer measurement noise for gravity based observations.

EKF2_GSF_TAS.short: Default value of true airspeed used in EKF-GSF AHRS calculation.
EKF2_GSF_TAS.long: If no airspeed measurements are available, the EKF-GSF AHRS calculation will assume this value of true airspeed when compensating for centripetal acceleration during turns. Set to zero to disable centripetal acceleration compensation during fixed wing flight modes.

EKF2_GYR_B_LIM.long: The ekf gyro bias states will be limited to within a range equivalent to +- of this value.

EKF2_GYR_B_NOISE.short: Process noise for IMU rate gyro bias prediction.

EKF2_GYR_NOISE.short: Rate gyro noise for covariance prediction.

EKF2_HDG_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_HEAD_NOISE.short: Measurement noise for magnetic heading fusion.

EKF2_HGT_REF.short: Determines the reference source of height data used by the EKF.
EKF2_HGT_REF.long: When multiple height sources are enabled at the same time, the height estimate will always converge towards the reference height source selected by this parameter. The range sensor and vision options should only be used when for operation over a flat surface as the local NED origin will move up and down with ground level. If GPS is set as reference but altitude fusion is disabled in EKF2_GPS_CTRL, the GPS altitude is still used to initiaize the bias of the other height sensors.

EKF2_IMU_POS_X.short: X position of IMU in body frame.
EKF2_IMU_POS_X.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_IMU_POS_Y.short: Y position of IMU in body frame.
EKF2_IMU_POS_Y.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_IMU_POS_Z.short: Z position of IMU in body frame.
EKF2_IMU_POS_Z.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_MAG_ACCLIM.short: Horizontal acceleration threshold used for heading observability check.
EKF2_MAG_ACCLIM.long: The heading is assumed to be observable when the body acceleration is greater than this parameter when a global position/velocity aiding source is active.

EKF2_MAG_B_NOISE.short: Process noise for body magnetic field prediction.

EKF2_MAG_CHECK.long: Bitmask to set which check is used to decide whether the magnetometer data is valid. If GNSS data is received, the magnetic field is compared to a World Magnetic Model (WMM), otherwise an average value is used. This check is useful to reject occasional hard iron disturbance. Set bits to 1 to enable checks. Checks enabled by the following bit positions 0 : Magnetic field strength. Set tolerance using EKF2_MAG_CHK_STR 1 : Magnetic field inclination. Set tolerance using EKF2_MAG_CHK_INC 2 : Wait for GNSS to find the theoretical strength and inclination using the WMM

EKF2_MAG_CHK_INC.long: Maximum allowed deviation from the expected magnetic field inclination to pass the check.

EKF2_MAG_CHK_STR.long: Maximum allowed deviation from the expected magnetic field strength to pass the check.

EKF2_MAG_DELAY.short: Magnetometer measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_MAG_E_NOISE.short: Process noise for earth magnetic field prediction.

EKF2_MAG_GATE.short: Gate size for magnetometer XYZ component fusion.
EKF2_MAG_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_MAG_TYPE.long: Integer controlling the type of magnetometer fusion used - magnetic heading or 3-component vector. The fusion of magnetometer data as a three component vector enables vehicle body fixed hard iron errors to be learned, but requires a stable earth field. If set to 'Automatic' magnetic heading fusion is used when on-ground and 3-axis magnetic field fusion in-flight. If set to 'Magnetic heading' magnetic heading fusion is used at all times. If set to 'None' the magnetometer will not be used under any circumstance. If no external source of yaw is available, it is possible to use post-takeoff horizontal movement combined with GNSS velocity measurements to align the yaw angle. If set to 'Init' the magnetometer is only used to initalize the heading.

EKF2_MCOEF.short: Propeller momentum drag coefficient for multi-rotor wind estimation.
EKF2_MCOEF.long: This parameter controls the prediction of drag produced by the propellers when flying a multi-copter, which enables estimation of wind drift when enabled by the EKF2_DRAG_CTRL parameter. The drag produced by this effect scales with speed not speed squared and is produced because some of the air velocity normal to the propeller axis of rotation is lost when passing through the rotor disc. This changes the momentum of the flow which creates a drag reaction force. When comparing un-ducted propellers of the same diameter, the effect is roughly proportional to the area of the propeller blades when viewed side on and changes with propeller selection. Momentum drag is significantly higher for ducted rotors. To account for the drag produced by the body which scales with speed squared, see documentation for the EKF2_BCOEF_X and EKF2_BCOEF_Y parameters. Set this parameter to zero to turn off the momentum drag model for both axis.

EKF2_MIN_RNG.short: Expected range finder reading when on ground.
EKF2_MIN_RNG.long: If the vehicle is on ground, is not moving as determined by the motion test and the range finder is returning invalid or no data, then an assumed range value of EKF2_MIN_RNG will be used by the terrain estimator so that a terrain height estimate is available at the start of flight in situations where the range finder may be inside its minimum measurements distance when on ground.

EKF2_MULTI_IMU.long: Maximum number of IMUs to use for Multi-EKF. Set 0 to disable. Requires SENS_IMU_MODE 0.

EKF2_MULTI_MAG.long: Maximum number of magnetometers to use for Multi-EKF. Set 0 to disable. Requires SENS_MAG_MODE 0.

EKF2_NOAID_NOISE.short: Measurement noise for non-aiding position hold.

EKF2_NOAID_TOUT.long: Maximum lapsed time from last fusion of measurements that constrain velocity drift before the EKF will report the horizontal nav solution as invalid

EKF2_OF_DELAY.short: Optical flow measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.
EKF2_OF_DELAY.long: Assumes measurement is timestamped at trailing edge of integration period

EKF2_OF_GATE.short: Gate size for optical flow fusion.
EKF2_OF_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_OF_GYR_SRC.short: Optical flow angular rate compensation source.
EKF2_OF_GYR_SRC.long: Auto: use gyro from optical flow message if available, internal gyro otherwise. Internal: always use internal gyro

EKF2_OF_N_MAX.long: Measurement noise for the optical flow sensor when it's reported quality metric is at the minimum

EKF2_OF_N_MIN.long: Measurement noise for the optical flow sensor when it's reported quality metric is at the maximum

EKF2_OF_POS_X.short: X position of optical flow focal point in body frame.
EKF2_OF_POS_X.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_OF_POS_Y.short: Y position of optical flow focal point in body frame.
EKF2_OF_POS_Y.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_OF_POS_Z.short: Z position of optical flow focal point in body frame.
EKF2_OF_POS_Z.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_OF_QMIN.short: In air optical flow minimum quality.
EKF2_OF_QMIN.long: Optical Flow data will only be used in air if the sensor reports a quality metric >= EKF2_OF_QMIN

EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND.short: On ground optical flow minimum quality.
EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND.long: Optical Flow data will only be used on the ground if the sensor reports a quality metric >= EKF2_OF_QMIN_GND

EKF2_PCOEF_XN.short: Static pressure position error coefficient for the negative X axis.
EKF2_PCOEF_XN.long: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a negative wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during backwards flight, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_XP.short: Static pressure position error coefficient for the positive X axis.
EKF2_PCOEF_XP.long: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a positive wind relative velocity along the X body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during forward flight, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_YN.short: Pressure position error coefficient for the negative Y axis.
EKF2_PCOEF_YN.long: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the negative Y (LH) body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the left, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_YP.short: Pressure position error coefficient for the positive Y axis.
EKF2_PCOEF_YP.long: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the positive Y (RH) body axis. If the baro height estimate rises during sideways flight to the right, then this will be a negative number.

EKF2_PCOEF_Z.short: Static pressure position error coefficient for the Z axis.
EKF2_PCOEF_Z.long: This is the ratio of static pressure error to dynamic pressure generated by a wind relative velocity along the Z body axis.

EKF2_PREDICT_US.long: EKF prediction period in microseconds. This should ideally be an integer multiple of the IMU time delta. Actual filter update will be an integer multiple of IMU update.

EKF2_REQ_GPS_H.short: Required GPS health time on startup.
EKF2_REQ_GPS_H.long: Minimum continuous period without GPS failure required to mark a healthy GPS status. It can be reduced to speed up initialization, but it's recommended to keep this unchanged for a vehicle.

EKF2_REQ_HDRIFT.short: Maximum horizontal drift speed to use GPS.

EKF2_REQ_NSATS.short: Required satellite count to use GPS.

EKF2_REQ_SACC.short: Required speed accuracy to use GPS.

EKF2_REQ_VDRIFT.short: Maximum vertical drift speed to use GPS.

EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX.short: Maximum height above ground allowed for conditional range aid mode.
EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX.long: If the vehicle absolute altitude exceeds this value then the estimator will not fuse range measurements to estimate its height. This only applies when conditional range aid mode is activated (EKF2_RNG_CTRL = 1).

EKF2_RNG_A_IGATE.short: Gate size used for innovation consistency checks for range aid fusion.
EKF2_RNG_A_IGATE.long: A lower value means HAGL needs to be more stable in order to use range finder for height estimation in range aid mode

EKF2_RNG_A_VMAX.short: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed for conditional range aid mode.
EKF2_RNG_A_VMAX.long: If the vehicle horizontal speed exceeds this value then the estimator will not fuse range measurements to estimate its height. This only applies when conditional range aid mode is activated (EKF2_RNG_CTRL = 1).

EKF2_RNG_CTRL.long: WARNING: Range finder measurements are less reliable and can experience unexpected errors. For these reasons, if accurate control of height relative to ground is required, it is recommended to use the MPC_ALT_MODE parameter instead, unless baro errors are severe enough to cause problems with landing and takeoff. If this parameter is enabled then the estimator will make use of the range finder measurements to estimate its height in addition to other height sources (if activated). Range sensor aiding can be enabled (i.e.: always use) or set in "conditional" mode. Conditional mode: This enables the range finder to be used during low speed (< EKF2_RNG_A_VMAX) and low altitude (< EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX) operation, eg takeoff and landing, where baro interference from rotor wash is excessive and can corrupt EKF state estimates. It is intended to be used where a vertical takeoff and landing is performed, and horizontal flight does not occur until above EKF2_RNG_A_HMAX.

EKF2_RNG_DELAY.short: Range finder measurement delay relative to IMU measurements.

EKF2_RNG_FOG.short: Maximum distance at which the range finder could detect fog (m).
EKF2_RNG_FOG.long: Limit for fog detection. If the range finder measures a distance greater than this value, the measurement is considered to not be blocked by fog or rain. If there's a jump from larger than RNG_FOG to smaller than EKF2_RNG_FOG, the measurement may gets rejected. 0 - disabled

EKF2_RNG_GATE.short: Gate size for range finder fusion.
EKF2_RNG_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_RNG_K_GATE.short: Gate size used for range finder kinematic consistency check.
EKF2_RNG_K_GATE.long: To be used, the time derivative of the distance sensor measurements projected on the vertical axis needs to be statistically consistent with the estimated vertical velocity of the drone. Decrease this value to make the filter more robust against range finder faulty data (stuck, reflections, ...). Note: tune the range finder noise parameters (EKF2_RNG_NOISE and EKF2_RNG_SFE) before tuning this gate.

EKF2_RNG_NOISE.short: Measurement noise for range finder fusion.

EKF2_RNG_POS_X.short: X position of range finder origin in body frame.
EKF2_RNG_POS_X.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_RNG_POS_Y.short: Y position of range finder origin in body frame.
EKF2_RNG_POS_Y.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_RNG_POS_Z.short: Z position of range finder origin in body frame.
EKF2_RNG_POS_Z.long: Forward axis with origin relative to vehicle centre of gravity

EKF2_RNG_QLTY_T.long: Minimum duration during which the reported range finder signal quality needs to be non-zero in order to be declared valid (s)

EKF2_RNG_SFE.short: Range finder range dependent noise scaler.
EKF2_RNG_SFE.long: Specifies the increase in range finder noise with range.

EKF2_SEL_ERR_RED.long: EKF2 instances have to be better than the selected by at least this amount before their relative score can be reduced.

EKF2_SEL_IMU_ACC.long: EKF2 selector acceleration error threshold for comparing accelerometers. Acceleration vector differences larger than this will result in accumulated velocity error.

EKF2_SEL_IMU_ANG.long: EKF2 selector maximum accumulated angular error threshold for comparing gyros. Accumulated angular error larger than this will result in the sensor being declared faulty.

EKF2_SEL_IMU_RAT.long: EKF2 selector angular rate error threshold for comparing gyros. Angular rate vector differences larger than this will result in accumulated angular error.

EKF2_SEL_IMU_VEL.long: EKF2 selector maximum accumulated velocity threshold for comparing accelerometers. Accumulated velocity error larger than this will result in the sensor being declared faulty.

EKF2_SYNT_MAG_Z.short: Enable synthetic magnetometer Z component measurement.
EKF2_SYNT_MAG_Z.long: Use for vehicles where the measured body Z magnetic field is subject to strong magnetic interference. For magnetic heading fusion the magnetometer Z measurement will be replaced by a synthetic value calculated using the knowledge of the 3D magnetic field vector at the location of the drone. Therefore, this parameter will only have an effect if the global position of the drone is known. For 3D mag fusion the magnetometer Z measurement will simply be ignored instead of fusing the synthetic value.

EKF2_TAS_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_TAU_POS.long: Controls how tightly the output track the EKF states

EKF2_TAU_VEL.short: Time constant of the velocity output prediction and smoothing filter.

EKF2_WIND_NSD.short: Process noise spectral density for wind velocity prediction.
EKF2_WIND_NSD.long: When unaided, the wind estimate uncertainty (1-sigma, in m/s) increases by this amount every second.

EV_TSK_RC_LOSS.long: Enable/disable event task for RC Loss. When enabled, an alarm tune will be played via buzzer or ESCs, if supported. The alarm will sound after a disarm, if the vehicle was previously armed and only if the vehicle had RC signal at some point. Particularly useful for locating crashed drones without a GPS sensor.

EV_TSK_STAT_DIS.long: Enable/disable event task for displaying the vehicle status using arm-mounted LEDs. When enabled and if the vehicle supports it, LEDs will flash indicating various vehicle status changes. Currently PX4 has not implemented any specific status events. -

FW_MAN_P_MAX.long: Applies to both directions in all manual modes with attitude stabilization but without altitude control

FW_MAN_R_MAX.long: Applies to both directions in all manual modes with attitude stabilization

FW_MAN_YR_MAX.long: This is the maximally added yaw rate setpoint from the yaw stick in any attitude controlled flight mode. It is added to the yaw rate setpoint generated by the controller for turn coordination.

FW_PSP_OFF.short: Pitch setpoint offset (pitch at level flight).
FW_PSP_OFF.long: An airframe specific offset of the pitch setpoint in degrees, the value is added to the pitch setpoint and should correspond to the pitch at typical cruise speed of the airframe.

FW_P_RMAX_NEG.short: Maximum negative / down pitch rate setpoint.

FW_P_RMAX_POS.short: Maximum positive / up pitch rate setpoint.

FW_P_TC.long: This defines the latency between a pitch step input and the achieved setpoint (inverse to a P gain). Smaller systems may require smaller values.

FW_R_TC.long: This defines the latency between a roll step input and the achieved setpoint (inverse to a P gain). Smaller systems may require smaller values.

FW_WR_I.long: This gain defines how much control response will result out of a steady state error. It trims any constant error.

FW_WR_P.long: This defines how much the wheel steering input will be commanded depending on the current body angular rate error.

FW_W_EN.long: Only enabled during automatic runway takeoff and landing. In all manual modes the wheel is directly controlled with yaw stick.

FW_W_RMAX.long: This limits the maximum wheel steering rate the controller will output (in degrees per second).

FW_LND_ABORT.short: Bit mask to set the automatic landing abort conditions.
FW_LND_ABORT.long: Terrain estimation: bit 0: Abort if terrain is not found bit 1: Abort if terrain times out (after a first successful measurement) The last estimate is always used as ground, whether the last valid measurement or the land waypoint, depending on the selected abort criteria, until an abort condition is entered. If FW_LND_USETER == 0, these bits are ignored. TODO: Extend automatic abort conditions e.g. glide slope tracking error (horizontal and vertical)

bits.0: Abort if terrain is not found (only applies to mission landings)
bits.1: Abort if terrain times out (after a first successful measurement)

FW_LND_AIRSPD.long: The calibrated airspeed setpoint during landing. If set <= 0, landing airspeed = FW_AIRSPD_MIN by default.

FW_LND_ANG.long: Typically the desired landing slope angle when landing configuration (flaps, airspeed) is enabled. Set this value within the vehicle's performance limits.

FW_LND_EARLYCFG.long: Allows to deploy the landing configuration (flaps, landing airspeed, etc.) already in the loiter-down waypoint before the final approach. Otherwise is enabled only in the final approach.

FW_LND_FLALT.short: Landing flare altitude (relative to landing altitude).
FW_LND_FLALT.long: NOTE: max(FW_LND_FLALT, FW_LND_FL_TIME * |z-velocity|) is taken as the flare altitude

FW_LND_FL_SINK.long: TECS will attempt to control the aircraft to this sink rate via pitch angle (throttle killed during flare)

FW_LND_FL_TIME.long: Multiplied by the descent rate to calculate a dynamic altitude at which to trigger the flare. NOTE: max(FW_LND_FLALT, FW_LND_FL_TIME * descent rate) is taken as the flare altitude

FW_LND_NUDGE.long: Approach angle nudging: shifts the touchdown point laterally while keeping the approach entrance point constant Approach path nudging: shifts the touchdown point laterally along with the entire approach path This is useful for manually adjusting the landing point in real time when map or GNSS errors cause an offset from the desired landing vector. Nudging is done with yaw stick, constrained to FW_LND_TD_OFF (in meters) and the direction is relative to the vehicle heading (stick deflection to the right = land point moves to the right as seen by the vehicle).

FW_LND_TD_OFF.short: Maximum lateral position offset for the touchdown point.

FW_LND_TD_TIME.long: This is the time after the start of flaring that we expect the vehicle to touch the runway. At this time, a 0.5s clamp down ramp will engage, constraining the pitch setpoint to RWTO_PSP. If enabled, ensure that RWTO_PSP is configured appropriately for full gear contact on ground roll. Set to -1.0 to disable touchdown clamping. E.g. it may not be desirable to clamp on belly landings. The touchdown time will be constrained to be greater than or equal to the flare time (FW_LND_FL_TIME).

FW_LND_THRTC_SC.short: Altitude time constant factor for landing and low-height flight.
FW_LND_THRTC_SC.long: The TECS altitude time constant (FW_T_ALT_TC) is multiplied by this value.

FW_LND_USETER.long: This is critical for detecting when to flare, and should be enabled if possible. If enabled and no measurement is found within a given timeout, the landing waypoint altitude will be used OR the landing will be aborted, depending on the criteria set in FW_LND_ABORT. If disabled, FW_LND_ABORT terrain based criteria are ignored.

values.1: Use the terrain estimate to trigger the flare (only)
values.2: Calculate landing glide slope relative to the terrain estimate

FW_WING_HEIGHT.short: Height (AGL) of the wings when the aircraft is on the ground.
FW_WING_HEIGHT.long: This is used to constrain a minimum altitude below which we keep wings level to avoid wing tip strike. It's safer to give a slight margin here (> 0m)

FW_WING_SPAN.short: The aircraft's wing span (length from tip to tip).
FW_WING_SPAN.long: This is used for limiting the roll setpoint near the ground. (if multiple wings, take the longest span)

FW_LAUN_AC_T.long: Launch is detected when acceleration in body forward direction is above FW_LAUN_AC_THLD for FW_LAUN_AC_T seconds.

FW_LAUN_AC_THLD.long: Launch is detected when acceleration in body forward direction is above FW_LAUN_AC_THLD for FW_LAUN_AC_T seconds.

FW_LAUN_DETCN_ON.long: Enables automatic launch detection based on measured acceleration. Use for hand- or catapult-launched vehicles. Not compatible with runway takeoff.

FW_LAUN_MOT_DEL.long: Start the motor(s) this amount of seconds after launch is detected.

NPFG_DAMPING.long: Damping ratio of NPFG control law.

NPFG_EN_MIN_GSP.short: Enable minimum forward ground speed maintaining excess wind handling logic.

NPFG_GSP_MAX_TK.short: Maximum, minimum forward ground speed for track keeping in excess wind.
NPFG_GSP_MAX_TK.long: The maximum value of the minimum forward ground speed that may be commanded by the track keeping excess wind handling logic. Commanded in full at the normalized track error fraction of the track error boundary and reduced to zero on track.

NPFG_LB_PERIOD.short: Enable automatic lower bound on the NPFG period.
NPFG_LB_PERIOD.long: Avoids limit cycling from a too aggressively tuned period/damping combination. If false, also disables upper bound NPFG_PERIOD_UB.

NPFG_PERIOD_SF.long: Multiplied by period for conservative minimum period bounding (when period lower bounding is enabled). 1.0 bounds at marginal stability.

NPFG_ROLL_TC.long: Time constant of roll controller command / response, modeled as first order delay. Used to determine lower period bound. Setting zero disables automatic period bounding.

NPFG_SW_DST_MLT.long: Multiplied by the track error boundary to determine when the aircraft switches to the next waypoint and/or path segment. Should be less than 1.

NPFG_TRACK_KEEP.short: Enable track keeping excess wind handling logic.

NPFG_UB_PERIOD.short: Enable automatic upper bound on the NPFG period.
NPFG_UB_PERIOD.long: Adapts period to maintain track keeping in variable winds and path curvature.

NPFG_WIND_REG.long: Disabling this parameter further disables all other airspeed incrementation options.

FW_PN_R_SLEW_MAX.short: Path navigation roll slew rate limit.
FW_PN_R_SLEW_MAX.long: Maximum change in roll angle setpoint per second. Applied in all Auto modes, plus manual Position & Altitude modes.

FW_POS_STK_CONF.long: Applies in manual Position and Altitude flight modes.

bits.0: Alternative stick configuration (height rate on throttle stick, airspeed on pitch stick)
bits.1: Enable airspeed setpoint via sticks in altitude and position flight mode

FW_R_LIM.long: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

FW_AIRSPD_MAX.long: The maximal airspeed (calibrated airspeed) the user is able to command.

FW_AIRSPD_MIN.long: The minimal airspeed (calibrated airspeed) the user is able to command. Further, if the airspeed falls below this value, the TECS controller will try to increase airspeed more aggressively. Has to be set according to the vehicle's stall speed (which should be set in FW_AIRSPD_STALL), with some margin between the stall speed and minimum airspeed. This value corresponds to the desired minimum speed with the default load factor (level flight, default weight), and is automatically adpated to the current load factor (calculated from roll setpoint and WEIGHT_GROSS/WEIGHT_BASE).

FW_AIRSPD_STALL.long: The stall airspeed (calibrated airspeed) of the vehicle. It is used for airspeed sensor failure detection and for the control surface scaling airspeed limits.

FW_AIRSPD_TRIM.long: The trim CAS (calibrated airspeed) of the vehicle. If an airspeed controller is active, this is the default airspeed setpoint that the controller will try to achieve. This value corresponds to the trim airspeed with the default load factor (level flight, default weight).

FW_SERVICE_CEIL.long: Altitude in standard atmosphere at which the vehicle in normal configuration (WEIGHT_BASE) is still able to achieve a maximum climb rate of 0.5m/s at maximum throttle (FW_THR_MAX). Used to compensate for air density in FW_T_CLMB_MAX. Set negative to disable.

FW_THR_ASPD_MAX.long: Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at maximum airspeed FW_AIRSPD_MAX Set to 0 to disable mapping of airspeed to trim throttle.

FW_THR_ASPD_MIN.long: Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at minimum airspeed FW_AIRSPD_MIN Set to 0 to disable mapping of airspeed to trim throttle below FW_AIRSPD_TRIM.

FW_THR_TRIM.long: Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at FW_AIRSPD_TRIM

FW_T_CLMB_MAX.long: This is the maximum calibrated climb rate that the aircraft can achieve with the throttle set to FW_THR_MAX and the airspeed set to the trim value. For electric aircraft make sure this number can be achieved towards the end of flight when the battery voltage has reduced.

FW_T_SINK_MIN.long: This is the minimum calibrated sink rate of the aircraft with the throttle set to THR_MIN and flown at the same airspeed as used to measure FW_T_CLMB_MAX.

WEIGHT_BASE.long: This is the weight of the vehicle at which it's performance limits were derived. A zero or negative value disables trim throttle and minimum airspeed compensation based on weight.

WEIGHT_GROSS.long: This is the actual weight of the vehicle at any time. This value will differ from WEIGHT_BASE in case weight was added or removed from the base weight. Examples are the addition of payloads or larger batteries. A zero or negative value disables trim throttle and minimum airspeed compensation based on weight.

FW_ACRO_X_MAX.short: Acro body roll max rate setpoint.

FW_ACRO_YAW_EN.short: Enable yaw rate controller in Acro.
FW_ACRO_YAW_EN.long: If this parameter is set to 1, the yaw rate controller is enabled in Fixed-wing Acro mode. Otherwise the pilot commands directly the yaw actuator. It is disabled by default because an active yaw rate controller will fight against the natural turn coordination of the plane.

FW_ACRO_Y_MAX.short: Acro body pitch max rate setpoint.

FW_ACRO_Z_MAX.short: Acro body yaw max rate setpoint.

FW_ARSP_SCALE_EN.long: This enables a logic that automatically adjusts the output of the rate controller to take into account the real torque produced by an aerodynamic control surface given the current deviation from the trim airspeed (FW_AIRSPD_TRIM). Enable when using aerodynamic control surfaces (e.g.: plane) Disable when using rotor wings (e.g.: autogyro)

FW_BAT_SCALE_EN.short: Enable throttle scale by battery level.
FW_BAT_SCALE_EN.long: This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to normalize performance across the operating range of the battery.

FW_DTRIM_P_VMAX.short: Pitch trim increment at maximum airspeed.
FW_DTRIM_P_VMAX.long: This increment is added to TRIM_PITCH when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

FW_DTRIM_P_VMIN.short: Pitch trim increment at minimum airspeed.
