FW_DTRIM_P_VMIN.long: This increment is added to TRIM_PITCH when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

FW_DTRIM_R_VMAX.short: Roll trim increment at maximum airspeed.
FW_DTRIM_R_VMAX.long: This increment is added to TRIM_ROLL when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

FW_DTRIM_R_VMIN.short: Roll trim increment at minimum airspeed.
FW_DTRIM_R_VMIN.long: This increment is added to TRIM_ROLL when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

FW_DTRIM_Y_VMAX.short: Yaw trim increment at maximum airspeed.
FW_DTRIM_Y_VMAX.long: This increment is added to TRIM_YAW when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

FW_DTRIM_Y_VMIN.short: Yaw trim increment at minimum airspeed.
FW_DTRIM_Y_VMIN.long: This increment is added to TRIM_YAW when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

FW_FLAPS_LND_SCL.long: Sets a fraction of full flaps during landing. Also applies to flaperons if enabled in the mixer/allocation.

FW_FLAPS_TO_SCL.long: Sets a fraction of full flaps during take-off. Also applies to flaperons if enabled in the mixer/allocation.

FW_MAN_P_SC.long: Scale factor applied to the desired pitch actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

FW_MAN_R_SC.long: Scale factor applied to the desired roll actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

FW_MAN_Y_SC.long: Scale factor applied to the desired yaw actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

FW_PR_FF.long: Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to control surface output

FW_RLL_TO_YAW_FF.short: Roll control to yaw control feedforward gain.
FW_RLL_TO_YAW_FF.long: This gain can be used to counteract the "adverse yaw" effect for fixed wings. When the plane enters a roll it will tend to yaw the nose out of the turn. This gain enables the use of a yaw actuator to counteract this effect.

FW_RR_FF.long: Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to control surface output.

FW_SPOILERS_MAN.long: Chose source for manual setting of spoilers in manual flight modes.

FW_USE_AIRSPD.long: If set to 1, the airspeed measurement data, if valid, is used in the following controllers: - Rate controller: output scaling - Attitude controller: coordinated turn controller - Position controller: airspeed setpoint tracking, takeoff logic - VTOL: transition logic

FW_YR_FF.long: Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to control surface output

FW_GND_SPD_MIN.long: The controller will increase the commanded airspeed to maintain this minimum groundspeed to the next waypoint.

FW_P_LIM_MAX.long: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

FW_P_LIM_MIN.long: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

FW_THR_IDLE.long: This is the minimum throttle while on the ground ("landed") in auto modes.

FW_THR_MAX.long: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode. Should be set accordingly to achieve FW_T_CLMB_MAX.

FW_THR_MIN.long: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode. Usually set to 0 but can be increased to prevent the motor from stopping when descending, which can increase achievable descent rates.

FW_THR_SLEW_MAX.long: Maximum slew rate for the commanded throttle

FW_TKO_AIRSPD.long: The calibrated airspeed setpoint during the takeoff climbout. If set <= 0, FW_AIRSPD_MIN will be set by default.

FW_T_CLMB_R_SP.long: In auto modes: default climb rate output by controller to achieve altitude setpoints. In manual modes: maximum climb rate setpoint.

FW_T_F_ALT_ERR.long: Minimum altitude error needed to descend with max airspeed and minimal throttle. A negative value disables fast descend.

FW_T_I_GAIN_PIT.long: Increase it to trim out speed and height offsets faster, with the downside of possible overshoots and oscillations.

FW_T_RLL2THR.long: Is used to compensate for the additional drag created by turning. Increase this gain if the aircraft initially loses energy in turns and reduce if the aircraft initially gains energy in turns.

FW_T_SEB_R_FF.short: Specific total energy balance rate feedforward gain.

FW_T_SINK_R_SP.long: In auto modes: default sink rate output by controller to achieve altitude setpoints. In manual modes: maximum sink rate setpoint.

FW_T_SPDWEIGHT.long: Adjusts the amount of weighting that the pitch control applies to speed vs height errors. 0 -> control height only 2 -> control speed only (gliders)

FW_T_SPD_DEV_STD.long: For the airspeed filter in TECS.

FW_T_SPD_PRC_STD.short: Process noise standard deviation for the airspeed rate.
FW_T_SPD_PRC_STD.long: This is defining the noise in the airspeed rate for the constant airspeed rate model of the TECS airspeed filter.

FW_T_SPD_STD.long: For the airspeed filter in TECS.

FW_T_STE_R_TC.short: Specific total energy rate first order filter time constant.
FW_T_STE_R_TC.long: This filter is applied to the specific total energy rate used for throttle damping.

FW_T_THR_DAMPING.long: This is the damping gain for the throttle demand loop.

FW_T_THR_INTEG.long: Increase it to trim out speed and height offsets faster, with the downside of possible overshoots and oscillations.

FW_T_THR_LOW_HGT.short: Low-height threshold for tighter altitude tracking.
FW_T_THR_LOW_HGT.long: Height above ground threshold below which tighter altitude tracking gets enabled (see FW_LND_THRTC_SC). Below this height, TECS smoothly (1 sec / sec) transitions the altitude tracking time constant from FW_T_ALT_TC to FW_LND_THRTC_SC*FW_T_ALT_TC. -1 to disable.

FW_T_VERT_ACC.long: This is the maximum vertical acceleration either up or down that the controller will use to correct speed or height errors.

FW_WIND_ARSP_SC.long: Multiplying this factor with the current absolute wind estimate gives the airspeed offset added to the minimum airspeed setpoint limit. This helps to make the system more robust against disturbances (turbulence) in high wind.

FD_ACT_EN.long: If enabled, failure detector will verify that for motors, a minimum amount of ESC current per throttle level is being consumed. Otherwise this indicates an motor failure.

FD_ACT_MOT_C2T.long: Motor failure triggers only below this current value

FD_ACT_MOT_THR.long: Motor failure triggers only above this throttle value.

FD_ACT_MOT_TOUT.long: Motor failure triggers only if the throttle threshold and the current to throttle threshold are violated for this time.

FD_ESCS_EN.short: Enable checks on ESCs that report their arming state.
FD_ESCS_EN.long: If enabled, failure detector will verify that all the ESCs have successfully armed when the vehicle has transitioned to the armed state. Timeout for receiving an acknowledgement from the ESCs is 0.3s, if no feedback is received the failure detector will auto disarm the vehicle.

FD_EXT_ATS_EN.short: Enable PWM input on for engaging failsafe from an external automatic trigger system (ATS).
FD_EXT_ATS_EN.long: Enabled on either AUX5 or MAIN5 depending on board. External ATS is required by ASTM F3322-18.

FD_EXT_ATS_TRIG.short: The PWM threshold from external automatic trigger system for engaging failsafe.
FD_EXT_ATS_TRIG.long: External ATS is required by ASTM F3322-18.

FD_FAIL_P.long: Maximum pitch angle before FailureDetector triggers the attitude_failure flag. The flag triggers flight termination (if @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM = 0), which sets outputs to their failsafe values. On takeoff the flag triggers lockdown (irrespective of @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM), which disarms motors but does not set outputs to failsafe values. Setting this parameter to 0 disables the check

FD_FAIL_P_TTRI.long: Seconds (decimal) that pitch has to exceed FD_FAIL_P before being considered as a failure.

FD_FAIL_R.long: Maximum roll angle before FailureDetector triggers the attitude_failure flag. The flag triggers flight termination (if @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM = 0), which sets outputs to their failsafe values. On takeoff the flag triggers lockdown (irrespective of @CBRK_FLIGHTTERM), which disarms motors but does not set outputs to failsafe values. Setting this parameter to 0 disables the check

FD_FAIL_R_TTRI.long: Seconds (decimal) that roll has to exceed FD_FAIL_R before being considered as a failure.

FD_IMB_PROP_THR.long: Value at which the imbalanced propeller metric (based on horizontal and vertical acceleration variance) triggers a failure Setting this value to 0 disables the feature.

FLW_TGT_ALT_M.long: Maintain altitude or track target's altitude. When maintaining the altitude, the drone can crash into terrain when the target moves uphill. When tracking the target's altitude, the follow altitude FLW_TGT_HT should be high enough to prevent terrain collisions due to GPS inaccuracies of the target.

values.0: 2D Tracking: Maintain constant altitude relative to home and track XY position only
values.1: 2D + Terrain: Maintain constant altitude relative to terrain below and track XY position
values.2: 3D Tracking: Track target's altitude (be aware that GPS altitude bias usually makes this useless)

FLW_TGT_DST.long: The distance in meters to follow the target at

FLW_TGT_FA.long: Angle to follow the target from. 0.0 Equals straight in front of the target's course (direction of motion) and the angle increases in clockwise direction, meaning Right-side would be 90.0 degrees while Left-side is -90.0 degrees Note: When the user force sets the angle out of the min/max range, it will be wrapped (e.g. 480 -> 120) in the range to gracefully handle the out of range.

FLW_TGT_MAX_VEL.short: Maximum tangential velocity setting for generating the follow orbit trajectory.
FLW_TGT_MAX_VEL.long: This is the maximum tangential velocity the drone will circle around the target whenever an orbit angle setpoint changes. Higher value means more aggressive follow behavior.

FLW_TGT_RS.short: Responsiveness to target movement in Target Estimator.
FLW_TGT_RS.long: lower values increase the responsiveness to changing position, but also ignore less noise

GPS_1_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run Main GPS.

GPS_1_GNSS.short: GNSS Systems for Primary GPS (integer bitmask).
GPS_1_GNSS.long: This integer bitmask controls the set of GNSS systems used by the receiver. Check your receiver's documentation on how many systems are supported to be used in parallel. Currently this functionality is just implemented for u-blox receivers. When no bits are set, the receiver's default configuration should be used. Set bits true to enable: 0 : Use GPS (with QZSS) 1 : Use SBAS (multiple GPS augmentation systems) 2 : Use Galileo 3 : Use BeiDou 4 : Use GLONASS 5 : Use NAVIC

GPS_1_PROTOCOL.long: Select the GPS protocol over serial. Auto-detection will probe all protocols, and thus is a bit slower.

GPS_2_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run Secondary GPS.

GPS_2_GNSS.short: GNSS Systems for Secondary GPS (integer bitmask).
GPS_2_GNSS.long: This integer bitmask controls the set of GNSS systems used by the receiver. Check your receiver's documentation on how many systems are supported to be used in parallel. Currently this functionality is just implemented for u-blox receivers. When no bits are set, the receiver's default configuration should be used. Set bits true to enable: 0 : Use GPS (with QZSS) 1 : Use SBAS (multiple GPS augmentation systems) 2 : Use Galileo 3 : Use BeiDou 4 : Use GLONASS 5 : Use NAVIC

GPS_2_PROTOCOL.long: Select the GPS protocol over serial. Auto-detection will probe all protocols, and thus is a bit slower.

GPS_DUMP_COMM.long: If this is set to 1, all GPS communication data will be published via uORB, and written to the log file as gps_dump message. If this is set to 2, the main GPS is configured to output RTCM data, which is then logged as gps_dump and can be used for PPK.

GPS_SAT_INFO.long: Enable publication of satellite info (ORB_ID(satellite_info)) if possible. Not available on MTK.

GPS_UBX_BAUD2.long: Select a baudrate for the F9P's UART2 port. In GPS_UBX_MODE 1, 2, and 3, the F9P's UART2 port is configured to send/receive RTCM corrections. Set this to 57600 if you want to attach a telemetry radio on UART2.

GPS_UBX_DYNMODEL.long: u-blox receivers support different dynamic platform models to adjust the navigation engine to the expected application environment.

GPS_UBX_MODE.long: Select the u-blox configuration setup. Most setups will use the default, including RTK and dual GPS without heading. If rover has RTCM corrections from a static base (or other static correction source) coming in on UART2, then select Mode 5. The Heading mode requires 2 F9P devices to be attached. The main GPS will act as rover and output heading information, whereas the secondary will act as moving base. Modes 1 and 2 require each F9P UART1 to be connected to the Autopilot. In addition, UART2 on the F9P units are connected to each other. Modes 3 and 4 only require UART1 on each F9P connected to the Autopilot or Can Node. UART RX DMA is required. RTK is still possible with this setup.

values.1: Heading (Rover With Moving Base UART1 Connected To Autopilot, UART2 Connected To Moving Base)
values.2: Moving Base (UART1 Connected To Autopilot, UART2 Connected To Rover)
values.3: Heading (Rover With Moving Base UART1 Connected to Autopilot Or Can Node At 921600)
values.4: Moving Base (Moving Base UART1 Connected to Autopilot Or Can Node At 921600)
values.5: Rover with Static Base on UART2 (similar to Default, except coming in on UART2)

GPS_YAW_OFFSET.short: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS.
GPS_YAW_OFFSET.long: Heading offset angle for dual antenna GPS setups that support heading estimation. Set this to 0 if the antennas are parallel to the forward-facing direction of the vehicle and the rover (or Unicore primary) antenna is in front. The offset angle increases clockwise. Set this to 90 if the rover (or Unicore primary, or Septentrio Mosaic Aux) antenna is placed on the right side of the vehicle and the moving base antenna is on the left side. (Note: the Unicore primary antenna is the one connected on the right as seen from the top).

PPS_CAP_ENABLE.long: Enables the PPS capture module. This switches mode of FMU channel 7 to be the PPS input channel.

GF_ACTION.long: Note: Setting this value to 4 enables flight termination, which will kill the vehicle on violation of the fence.

GF_MAX_HOR_DIST.long: Maximum horizontal distance in meters the vehicle can be from Home before triggering a geofence action. Disabled if 0.

GF_MAX_VER_DIST.long: Maximum vertical distance in meters the vehicle can be from Home before triggering a geofence action. Disabled if 0.

GF_PREDICT.long: WARNING: This experimental feature may cause flyaways. Use at your own risk. Predict the motion of the vehicle and trigger the breach if it is determined that the current trajectory would result in a breach happening before the vehicle can make evasive maneuvers. The vehicle is then re-routed to a safe hold position (stop for multirotor, loiter for fixed wing).

GF_SOURCE.long: Select which position source should be used. Selecting GPS instead of global position makes sure that there is no dependence on the position estimator 0 = global position, 1 = GPS

CA_AIRFRAME.long: Defines which mixer implementation to use. Some are generic, while others are specifically fit to a certain vehicle with a fixed set of actuators. 'Custom' should only be used if noting else can be used.

CA_FAILURE_MODE.long: This is used to specify how to handle motor failures reported by failure detector.

values.1: Remove first failed motor from effectiveness

CA_HELI_PITCH_C0.long: Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 0 for a given thrust setpoint. Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C1.long: Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 1 for a given thrust setpoint. Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C2.long: Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 2 for a given thrust setpoint. Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C3.long: Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 3 for a given thrust setpoint. Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_PITCH_C4.long: Defines the collective pitch at the interval position 4 for a given thrust setpoint. Use negative values if the swash plate needs to move down to provide upwards thrust.

CA_HELI_RPM_I.long: Same definition as the proportional gain but for integral.

CA_HELI_RPM_P.long: Ratio between rpm error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it. motor_command = throttle_curve + CA_HELI_RPM_P * (rpm_setpoint - rpm_measurement) / 1000

CA_HELI_RPM_SP.long: Requires rpm feedback for the controller.

CA_HELI_THR_C0.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 0.

CA_HELI_THR_C1.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 1.

CA_HELI_THR_C2.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 2.

CA_HELI_THR_C3.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 3.

CA_HELI_THR_C4.long: Defines the output throttle at the interval position 4.

CA_HELI_YAW_CCW.long: Default configuration is for a clockwise turning main rotor and positive thrust of the tail rotor is expected to rotate the vehicle clockwise. Set this parameter to true if the tail rotor provides thrust in counter-clockwise direction which is mostly the case when the main rotor turns counter-clockwise.

CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O.short: Offset for yaw compensation based on collective pitch.
CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O.long: This allows to specify which collective pitch command results in the least amount of rotor drag. This is used to increase the accuracy of the yaw drag torque compensation based on collective pitch by aligning the lowest rotor drag with zero compensation. For symmetric profile blades this is the command that results in exactly 0° collective blade angle. For lift profile blades this is typically a command resulting in slightly negative collective blade angle. tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S.short: Scale for yaw compensation based on collective pitch.
CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S.long: This allows to add a proportional factor of the collective pitch command to the yaw command. A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction. tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_CP_S * abs(collective_pitch - CA_HELI_YAW_CP_O)

CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S.short: Scale for yaw compensation based on throttle.
CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S.long: This allows to add a proportional factor of the throttle command to the yaw command. A negative value is needed when positive thrust of the tail rotor rotates the vehicle opposite to the main rotor turn direction. tail_output += CA_HELI_YAW_TH_S * throttle

CA_MAX_SVO_THROW.short: Throw angle of swashplate servo at maximum commands for linearization.
CA_MAX_SVO_THROW.long: Used to linearize mechanical output of swashplate servos to avoid axis coupling and binding with 4 servo redundancy. This requires a symmetric setup where the servo horn is exactly centered with a 0 command. Setting to zero disables feature.

CA_METHOD.long: Selects the algorithm and desaturation method. If set to Automtic, the selection is based on the airframe (CA_AIRFRAME).

CA_R0_SLEW.long: Forces the motor output signal to take at least the configured time (in seconds) to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]). Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.

CA_R10_SLEW.long: Forces the motor output signal to take at least the configured time (in seconds) to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]). Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.

CA_R11_SLEW.long: Forces the motor output signal to take at least the configured time (in seconds) to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]). Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.

CA_R1_SLEW.long: Forces the motor output signal to take at least the configured time (in seconds) to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]). Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.

CA_R2_SLEW.long: Forces the motor output signal to take at least the configured time (in seconds) to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]). Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.

CA_R3_SLEW.long: Forces the motor output signal to take at least the configured time (in seconds) to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]). Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.

CA_R4_SLEW.long: Forces the motor output signal to take at least the configured time (in seconds) to traverse its full range (normally [0, 1], or if reversible [-1, 1]). Zero means that slew rate limiting is disabled.
