HTE_ACC_GATE.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

HTE_HT_ERR_INIT.long: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

HTE_HT_NOISE.long: Reduce to make the hover thrust estimate more stable, increase if the real hover thrust is expected to change quickly over time.

HTE_THR_RANGE.long: Defines the range of the hover thrust estimate around MPC_THR_HOVER. A value of 0.2 with MPC_THR_HOVER at 0.5 results in a range of [0.3, 0.7]. Set to a large value if the vehicle operates in varying physical conditions that affect the required hover thrust strongly (e.g. differently sized payloads).

HTE_VXY_THR.short: Horizontal velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction.
HTE_VXY_THR.long: Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement. Set to a low value on vehicles with large lifting surfaces.

HTE_VZ_THR.short: Vertical velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction.
HTE_VZ_THR.long: Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement. Set to a low value on vehicles affected by air drag when climbing or descending.

ICE_IGN_DELAY.short: Cold-start delay after ignition before engaging starter.
ICE_IGN_DELAY.long: In case that the ignition takes a moment to be up and running, this parameter can be set to account for that.

ICE_MIN_RUN_RPM.short: Minimum RPM for engine to be declared running.

ICE_RUN_FAULT_D.short: Fault detection if it stops in running state.
ICE_RUN_FAULT_D.long: Enables restart if a fault is detected during the running state. Otherwise commands continues in running state until given an user request off.

ICE_STRT_ATTEMPT.short: Number attempts for starting the engine.
ICE_STRT_ATTEMPT.long: Number of accepted attempts for starting the engine before declaring a fault.

ICE_STRT_DUR.short: Duration of single starting attempt (excl. choking).
ICE_STRT_DUR.long: Maximum expected time for startup before declaring timeout.

ICE_STRT_THR.long: During the choking and the starting phase, the throttle value is set to this value.

ICE_THR_SLEW.long: Maximum rate of change of throttle value per second.

ISBD_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run Iridium (with MAVLink).

ISBD_READ_INT.short: Satellite radio read interval. Only required to be nonzero if data is not sent using a ring call.

ISBD_STACK_TIME.short: Time the Iridium driver will wait for additional mavlink messages to combine them into one SBD message.

LNDFW_AIRSPD_MAX.long: Maximum airspeed allowed in the landed state

LNDFW_ROT_MAX.short: Fixed-wing land detector: max rotational speed.
LNDFW_ROT_MAX.long: Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity in the landed state.

LNDFW_TRIG_TIME.long: Time the land conditions (speeds and acceleration) have to be satisfied to detect a landing.

LNDFW_VEL_XY_MAX.short: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal velocity threshold.
LNDFW_VEL_XY_MAX.long: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state. A factor of 0.7 is applied in case of airspeed-less flying (either because no sensor is present or sensor data got invalid in flight).

LNDFW_VEL_Z_MAX.short: Fixed-wing land detector: Max vertiacal velocity threshold.
LNDFW_VEL_Z_MAX.long: Maximum vertical velocity allowed in the landed state.

LNDFW_XYACC_MAX.short: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal acceleration.
LNDFW_XYACC_MAX.long: Maximum horizontal (x,y body axes) acceleration allowed in the landed state

LNDMC_ALT_GND.long: The height above ground below which ground effect creates barometric altitude errors. A negative value indicates no ground effect.

LNDMC_ROT_MAX.long: Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity (roll, pitch) in the landed state.

LNDMC_TRIG_TIME.long: Total time it takes to go through all three land detection stages: ground contact, maybe landed, landed when all necessary conditions are constantly met.

LNDMC_XY_VEL_MAX.long: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state

LNDMC_Z_VEL_MAX.long: Vertical velocity threshold to detect landing. Has to be set lower than the expected minimal speed for landing, which is either MPC_LAND_SPEED or MPC_LAND_CRWL. This is enforced by an automatic check.

LND_FLIGHT_T_HI.long: Total flight time of this autopilot. Higher 32 bits of the value. Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.long: Total flight time of this autopilot. Lower 32 bits of the value. Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

LTEST_ACC_UNC.long: Variance of acceleration measurement used for landing target position prediction. Higher values results in tighter following of the measurements and more lenient outlier rejection

LTEST_MEAS_UNC.long: Variance of the landing target measurement from the driver. Higher values result in less aggressive following of the measurement and a smoother output as well as fewer rejected measurements.

LTEST_MODE.long: Configure the mode of the landing target. Depending on the mode, the landing target observations are used differently to aid position estimation. Mode Moving: The landing target may be moving around while in the field of view of the vehicle. Landing target measurements are not used to aid positioning. Mode Stationary: The landing target is stationary. Measured velocity w.r.t. the landing target is used to aid velocity estimation.

LTEST_POS_UNC_IN.long: Initial variance of the relative landing target position in x and y direction

LTEST_SCALE_X.short: Scale factor for sensor measurements in sensor x axis.
LTEST_SCALE_X.long: Landing target x measurements are scaled by this factor before being used

LTEST_SCALE_Y.short: Scale factor for sensor measurements in sensor y axis.
LTEST_SCALE_Y.long: Landing target y measurements are scaled by this factor before being used

LTEST_SENS_POS_X.short: X Position of IRLOCK in body frame (forward).

LTEST_SENS_POS_Y.short: Y Position of IRLOCK in body frame (right).

LTEST_SENS_POS_Z.short: Z Position of IRLOCK in body frame (downward).

LTEST_SENS_ROT.short: Rotation of IRLOCK sensor relative to airframe.

LTEST_VEL_UNC_IN.long: Initial variance of the relative landing target velocity in x and y directions

LPE_ACC_XY.long: Data sheet noise density = 150ug/sqrt(Hz) = 0.0015 m/s^2/sqrt(Hz) Larger than data sheet to account for tilt error.

LPE_BAR_Z.short: Barometric presssure altitude z standard deviation.

LPE_EPH_MAX.short: Max EPH allowed for GPS initialization.

LPE_EPV_MAX.short: Max EPV allowed for GPS initialization.

LPE_FAKE_ORIGIN.short: Enable publishing of a fake global position (e.g for AUTO missions using Optical Flow).
LPE_FAKE_ORIGIN.long: By initializing the estimator to the LPE_LAT/LON parameters when global information is unavailable

LPE_FGYRO_HP.short: Flow gyro high pass filter cut off frequency.

LPE_FLW_OFF_Z.short: Optical flow z offset from center.

LPE_FLW_RR.short: Optical flow angular velocity noise gain.

LPE_FUSION.long: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Set to true to fuse GPS data if available, also requires GPS for altitude init 1 : Set to true to fuse optical flow data if available 2 : Set to true to fuse vision position 3 : Set to true to enable landing target 4 : Set to true to fuse land detector 5 : Set to true to publish AGL as local position down component 6 : Set to true to enable flow gyro compensation 7 : Set to true to enable baro fusion default (145 - GPS, baro, land detector)

bits.0: fuse GPS, requires GPS for alt. init

LPE_GPS_VXY.long: EPV used if greater than this value.

LPE_GPS_XY.short: Minimum GPS xy standard deviation, uses reported EPH if greater.

LPE_GPS_Z.short: Minimum GPS z standard deviation, uses reported EPV if greater.

LPE_LAND_VXY.short: Land detector xy velocity standard deviation.

LPE_LAT.short: Local origin latitude for nav w/o GPS.

LPE_LDR_OFF_Z.short: Lidar z offset from center of vehicle +down.

LPE_LON.short: Local origin longitude for nav w/o GPS.

LPE_LT_COV.short: Minimum landing target standard covariance, uses reported covariance if greater.

LPE_PN_P.long: Increase to trust measurements more. Decrease to trust model more.

LPE_PN_T.short: Terrain random walk noise density, hilly/outdoor (0.1), flat/Indoor (0.001).

LPE_PN_V.long: Increase to trust measurements more. Decrease to trust model more.

LPE_SNR_OFF_Z.short: Sonar z offset from center of vehicle +down.

LPE_T_MAX_GRADE.short: Terrain maximum percent grade, hilly/outdoor (100 = 45 deg), flat/Indoor (0 = 0 deg).
LPE_T_MAX_GRADE.long: Used to calculate increased terrain random walk nosie due to movement.

LPE_VIS_DELAY.long: Set to zero to enable automatic compensation from measurement timestamps

LPE_VXY_PUB.short: Required velocity xy standard deviation to publish position.

LPE_Z_PUB.short: Required z standard deviation to publish altitude/ terrain.

MAV_0_BROADCAST.short: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 0.
MAV_0_BROADCAST.long: This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone on the local network.

MAV_0_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run MAVLink.

MAV_0_FLOW_CTRL.short: Enable serial flow control for instance 0.
MAV_0_FLOW_CTRL.long: This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.

MAV_0_FORWARD.short: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 0.
MAV_0_FORWARD.long: If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot. This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).

MAV_0_HL_FREQ.short: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0.
MAV_0_HL_FREQ.long: Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0, configured in iridium mode. This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.

MAV_0_MODE.long: The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

MAV_0_RADIO_CTL.short: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 0.
MAV_0_RADIO_CTL.long: If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to `txbuf` field reported by radio_status. Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.

MAV_0_RATE.short: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 0.
MAV_0_RATE.long: Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec. If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of each stream is automatically decreased. If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used. This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on 8N1-configured links).

MAV_0_REMOTE_PRT.long: If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0, selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

MAV_0_UDP_PRT.long: If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0, selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

MAV_1_BROADCAST.short: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 1.
MAV_1_BROADCAST.long: This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone on the local network.

MAV_1_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run MAVLink.

MAV_1_FLOW_CTRL.short: Enable serial flow control for instance 1.
MAV_1_FLOW_CTRL.long: This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.

MAV_1_FORWARD.short: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 1.
MAV_1_FORWARD.long: If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot. This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).

MAV_1_HL_FREQ.short: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 1.
MAV_1_HL_FREQ.long: Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 1, configured in iridium mode. This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.

MAV_1_MODE.long: The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

MAV_1_RADIO_CTL.short: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 1.
MAV_1_RADIO_CTL.long: If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to `txbuf` field reported by radio_status. Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.

MAV_1_RATE.short: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 1.
MAV_1_RATE.long: Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec. If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of each stream is automatically decreased. If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used. This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on 8N1-configured links).

MAV_1_REMOTE_PRT.long: If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 1, selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 1.

MAV_1_UDP_PRT.long: If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 1, selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 1.

MAV_2_BROADCAST.short: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 2.
MAV_2_BROADCAST.long: This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone on the local network.

MAV_2_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run MAVLink.

MAV_2_FLOW_CTRL.short: Enable serial flow control for instance 2.
MAV_2_FLOW_CTRL.long: This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.

MAV_2_FORWARD.short: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 2.
MAV_2_FORWARD.long: If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot. This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).

MAV_2_HL_FREQ.short: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 2.
MAV_2_HL_FREQ.long: Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 2, configured in iridium mode. This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.

MAV_2_MODE.long: The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

MAV_2_RADIO_CTL.short: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 2.
MAV_2_RADIO_CTL.long: If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to `txbuf` field reported by radio_status. Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.

MAV_2_RATE.short: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 2.
MAV_2_RATE.long: Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec. If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of each stream is automatically decreased. If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used. This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on 8N1-configured links).

MAV_2_REMOTE_PRT.long: If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 2, selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 2.

MAV_2_UDP_PRT.long: If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 2, selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 2.

MAV_FWDEXTSP.long: If set to 1 incoming external setpoint messages will be directly forwarded to the controllers if in offboard control mode

MAV_HASH_CHK_EN.long: Disabling the parameter hash check functionality will make the mavlink instance stream parameters continuously.

MAV_HB_FORW_EN.long: The mavlink heartbeat message will not be forwarded if this parameter is set to 'disabled'. The main reason for disabling heartbeats to be forwarded is because they confuse dronekit.

values.0: Default to 1, switch to 2 if GCS sends version 2

MAV_RADIO_TOUT.short: Timeout in seconds for the RADIO_STATUS reports coming in.
MAV_RADIO_TOUT.long: If the connected radio stops reporting RADIO_STATUS for a certain time, a warning is triggered and, if MAV_X_RADIO_CTL is enabled, the software-flow control is reset.

MAV_SIK_RADIO_ID.long: When non-zero the MAVLink app will attempt to configure the SiK radio to this ID and re-set the parameter to 0. If the value is negative it will reset the complete radio config to factory defaults. Only applies if this mavlink instance is going through a SiK radio

values.22: VTOL Standard (separate fixed rotors for hover and cruise flight)

MAV_USEHILGPS.short: Use/Accept HIL GPS message even if not in HIL mode.
MAV_USEHILGPS.long: If set to 1 incoming HIL GPS messages are parsed.

BMM350_AVG.long: Defines which averaging mode to use during data polling.

BMM350_DRIVE.long: This setting helps avoid signal problems like overshoot or undershoot.

BMM350_ODR.long: Defines which ODR rate to use during data polling.

MBE_ENABLE.long: This enables continuous calibration of the magnetometers before takeoff using gyro data.

MBE_LEARN_GAIN.long: Increase to make the estimator more responsive Decrease to make the estimator more robust to noise

MAN_ARM_GESTURE.long: This determines if moving the left stick to the lower right arms and to the lower left disarms the vehicle.

MAN_KILL_GEST_T.short: Trigger time for kill stick gesture.
MAN_KILL_GEST_T.long: The timeout for holding the left stick to the lower left and the right stick to the lower right at the same time until the gesture kills the actuators one-way. A negative value disables the feature.

FW_GPSF_LT.long: The time the system should do open loop loiter and wait for GPS recovery before it starts descending. Set to 0 to disable. Roll angle is set to FW_GPSF_R. Does only apply for fixed-wing vehicles or VTOLs with NAV_FORCE_VT set to 0.

FW_GPSF_R.long: Roll angle in GPS failure loiter mode.

MIS_COMMAND_TOUT.short: Timeout to allow the payload to execute the mission command.
MIS_COMMAND_TOUT.long: Ensure: gripper: NAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER has released before continuing mission. winch: CMD_DO_WINCH has delivered before continuing mission. gimbal: CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW has reached the commanded orientation before beginning to take pictures.

MIS_DIST_1WP.short: Maximal horizontal distance from Home to first waypoint.
MIS_DIST_1WP.long: There will be a warning message if the current waypoint is more distant than MIS_DIST_1WP from Home. Has no effect on mission validity. Set a value of zero or less to disable.

MIS_LND_ABRT_ALT.long: Minimum altitude above landing point that the vehicle will climb to after an aborted landing. Then vehicle will loiter in this altitude until further command is received. Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles.

MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.short: Enable yaw control of the mount. (Only affects multicopters and ROI mission items).
MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.long: If enabled, yaw commands will be sent to the mount and the vehicle will follow its heading towards the flight direction. If disabled, the vehicle will yaw towards the ROI.

MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT.long: This is the relative altitude the system will take off to if not otherwise specified.

MIS_TKO_LAND_REQ.long: Specifies if a mission has to contain a takeoff and/or mission landing. Validity of configured takeoffs/landings is checked independently of the setting here.

values.3: Require a takeoff and a landing
values.4: Require both a takeoff and a landing, or neither
values.5: Same as previous when landed, in-air require landing only if no valid VTOL approach is present

MIS_YAW_ERR.short: Max yaw error in degrees needed for waypoint heading acceptance.

MIS_YAW_TMT.short: Time in seconds we wait on reaching target heading at a waypoint if it is forced.
MIS_YAW_TMT.long: If set > 0 it will ignore the target heading for normal waypoint acceptance. If the waypoint forces the heading the timeout will matter. For example on VTOL forwards transition. Mainly useful for VTOLs that have less yaw authority and might not reach target yaw in wind. Disabled by default.

NAV_ACC_RAD.long: Default acceptance radius, overridden by acceptance radius of waypoint if set. For fixed wing the npfg switch distance is used for horizontal acceptance.

NAV_FORCE_VT.short: Force VTOL mode takeoff and land.

NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.short: FW Altitude Acceptance Radius before a landing.
NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.long: Altitude acceptance used for the last waypoint before a fixed-wing landing. This is usually smaller than the standard vertical acceptance because close to the ground higher accuracy is required.

NAV_LOITER_RAD.long: Default value of loiter radius in FW mode (e.g. for Loiter mode).

NAV_MIN_GND_DIST.short: Minimum height above ground during Mission and RTL.
NAV_MIN_GND_DIST.long: Minimum height above ground the vehicle is allowed to descend to during Mission and RTL, excluding landing commands. Requires a distance sensor to be set up. Note: only prevents the vehicle from descending further, but does not force it to climb. Set to a negative value to disable.

NAV_MIN_LTR_ALT.long: This is the minimum altitude above Home the system will always obey in Loiter (Hold) mode if switched into this mode without specifying an altitude (e.g. through Loiter switch on RC). Doesn't affect Loiters that are part of Missions or that are entered through a reposition setpoint ("Go to"). Set to a negative value to disable.

NAV_TRAFF_AVOID.long: Enabling this will allow the system to respond to transponder data from e.g. ADSB transponders

NAV_TRAFF_A_HOR.short: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID horizontal distance.

NAV_TRAFF_A_VER.short: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID vertical distance.

NAV_TRAFF_COLL_T.long: Minimum acceptable time until collsion. Assumes constant speed over 3d distance.

MC_AIRMODE.long: The air-mode enables the mixer to increase the total thrust of the multirotor in order to keep attitude and rate control even at low and high throttle. This function should be disabled during tuning as it will help the controller to diverge if the closed-loop is unstable (i.e. the vehicle is not tuned yet). Enabling air-mode for yaw requires the use of an arming switch.

MODALAI_CONFIG.long: This can be set to indicate that drone behavior needs to be changed to match a custom setting

MNT_DO_STAB.long: Set to true for servo gimbal, false for passthrough. This is required for a gimbal which is not capable of stabilizing itself and relies on the IMU's attitude estimation.

MNT_MAN_PITCH.short: Auxiliary channel to control pitch (in AUX input or manual mode).

MNT_MAN_ROLL.short: Auxiliary channel to control roll (in AUX input or manual mode).

MNT_MAN_YAW.short: Auxiliary channel to control yaw (in AUX input or manual mode).

MNT_MAV_COMPID.short: Mavlink Component ID of the mount.
MNT_MAV_COMPID.long: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink protocol v2, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this component ID.

MNT_MAV_SYSID.short: Mavlink System ID of the mount.
MNT_MAV_SYSID.long: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink gimbal protocol v1, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this target ID.

MNT_MODE_IN.long: This is the protocol used between the ground station and the autopilot. Recommended is Auto, RC only or MAVLink gimbal protocol v2. The rest will be deprecated.

values.0: Auto (RC and MAVLink gimbal protocol v2)

MNT_MODE_OUT.long: This is the protocol used between the autopilot and a connected gimbal. Recommended is the MAVLink gimbal protocol v2 if the gimbal supports it.

MNT_OFF_PITCH.short: Offset for pitch channel output in degrees.

MNT_OFF_ROLL.short: Offset for roll channel output in degrees.

MNT_OFF_YAW.short: Offset for yaw channel output in degrees.

MNT_RANGE_PITCH.short: Range of pitch channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode).

MNT_RANGE_ROLL.short: Range of roll channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode).

MNT_RANGE_YAW.short: Range of yaw channel output in degrees (only in AUX output mode).

MNT_RATE_PITCH.short: Angular pitch rate for manual input in degrees/second.
MNT_RATE_PITCH.long: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-pitch rate..pitch rate].

MNT_RATE_YAW.short: Angular yaw rate for manual input in degrees/second.
MNT_RATE_YAW.long: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-yaw rate..yaw rate].

MNT_RC_IN_MODE.short: Input mode for RC gimbal input.

MC_ACRO_EXPO.short: Acro mode roll, pitch expo factor.
MC_ACRO_EXPO.long: Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MC_ACRO_EXPO_Y.long: Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MC_ACRO_P_MAX.long: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

MC_ACRO_R_MAX.long: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

MC_ACRO_SUPEXPO.short: Acro mode roll, pitch super expo factor.
MC_ACRO_SUPEXPO.long: "Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using MC_ACRO_EXPO. 0 Pure Expo function 0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel 0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect

MC_ACRO_SUPEXPOY.short: Acro mode yaw super expo factor.
MC_ACRO_SUPEXPOY.long: "Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using MC_ACRO_EXPO_Y. 0 Pure Expo function 0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel 0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect

MC_ACRO_Y_MAX.long: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

MC_PITCHRATE_MAX.long: Limit for pitch rate in manual and auto modes (except acro). Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control output and mixer saturation. This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum measurement rate of the gyro.

MC_PITCH_P.long: Pitch proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_ROLLRATE_MAX.long: Limit for roll rate in manual and auto modes (except acro). Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control output and mixer saturation. This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum measurement rate of the gyro.

MC_ROLL_P.long: Roll proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_YAW_P.long: Yaw proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_YAW_WEIGHT.long: A fraction [0,1] deprioritizing yaw compared to roll and pitch in non-linear attitude control. Deprioritizing yaw is necessary because multicopters have much less control authority in yaw compared to the other axes and it makes sense because yaw is not critical for stable hovering or 3D navigation. For yaw control tuning use MC_YAW_P. This ratio has no impact on the yaw gain.

MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC.short: Maximum yaw acceleration in autonomous modes.
MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC.long: Limits the acceleration of the yaw setpoint to avoid large control output and mixer saturation.

MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.short: Maximum yaw rate in autonomous modes.
MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.long: Limits the rate of change of the yaw setpoint to avoid large control output and mixer saturation.

CP_DELAY.short: Average delay of the range sensor message plus the tracking delay of the position controller in seconds.

CP_DIST.short: Minimum distance the vehicle should keep to all obstacles.
CP_DIST.long: Only used in Position mode. Collision avoidance is disabled by setting this parameter to a negative value

CP_GO_NO_DATA.short: Boolean to allow moving into directions where there is no sensor data (outside FOV).

CP_GUIDE_ANG.short: Angle left/right from the commanded setpoint by which the collision prevention algorithm can choose to change the setpoint direction.

MC_MAN_TILT_TAU.short: Manual tilt input filter time constant.
MC_MAN_TILT_TAU.long: Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter

MPC_ACC_DECOUPLE.long: Set to decouple tilt from vertical acceleration. This provides smoother flight but slightly worse tracking in position and auto modes. Unset if accurate position tracking during dynamic maneuvers is more important than a smooth flight.

MPC_ACC_DOWN_MAX.short: Maximum downwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes.

MPC_ACC_HOR.short: Acceleration for autonomous and for manual modes.
MPC_ACC_HOR.long: When piloting manually, this parameter is only used in MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX.long: MPC_POS_MODE 1 just deceleration 4 not used, use MPC_ACC_HOR instead

MPC_ACC_UP_MAX.short: Maximum upwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes.

MPC_ALT_MODE.long: Control height 0: relative earth frame origin which may drift due to sensors 1: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) which changes with terrain variation. It will revert to relative earth frame if the distance to ground estimate becomes invalid. 2: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) when stationary and relative to earth frame when moving horizontally. The speed threshold is MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY

MPC_HOLD_DZ.short: Deadzone for sticks in manual piloted modes.
MPC_HOLD_DZ.long: Does not apply to manual throttle and direct attitude piloting by stick.

MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY.short: Maximum horizontal velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check).
MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY.long: Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Direct velocity or MPC_ALT_MODE 2

MPC_HOLD_MAX_Z.short: Maximum vertical velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check).

MPC_JERK_AUTO.long: Limit the maximum jerk of the vehicle (how fast the acceleration can change). A lower value leads to smoother vehicle motions but also limited agility.

MPC_JERK_MAX.short: Maximum horizontal and vertical jerk in Position/Altitude mode.
MPC_JERK_MAX.long: Limit the maximum jerk (acceleration change) of the vehicle. A lower value leads to smoother motions but limits agility. Setting this to the maximum value essentially disables the limit. Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.

MPC_LAND_ALT1.short: Altitude for 1. step of slow landing (descend).
MPC_LAND_ALT1.long: Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to a value between "MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN" (or "MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN") and "MPC_LAND_SPEED" Value needs to be higher than "MPC_LAND_ALT2"

MPC_LAND_ALT2.short: Altitude for 2. step of slow landing (landing).
MPC_LAND_ALT2.long: Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to "MPC_LAND_SPEED" Value needs to be lower than "MPC_LAND_ALT1"

MPC_LAND_ALT3.short: Altitude for 3. step of slow landing.
MPC_LAND_ALT3.long: Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to "MPC_LAND_CRWL", if LIDAR available. No effect if LIDAR not available

MPC_LAND_CRWL.long: Used below MPC_LAND_ALT3 if distance sensor data is availabe.

MPC_LAND_RADIUS.long: When nudging is enabled (see MPC_LAND_RC_HELP), this controls the maximum allowed horizontal displacement from the original landing point.

MPC_LAND_RC_HELP.short: Enable nudging based on user input during autonomous land routine.
MPC_LAND_RC_HELP.long: Using stick input the vehicle can be moved horizontally and yawed. The descend speed is amended: stick full up - 0 stick centered - MPC_LAND_SPEED stick full down - 2 * MPC_LAND_SPEED Manual override during auto modes has to be disabled to use this feature (see COM_RC_OVERRIDE).

MPC_MANTHR_MIN.short: Minimum collective thrust in Stabilized mode.
MPC_MANTHR_MIN.long: The value is mapped to the lowest throttle stick position in Stabilized mode. Too low collective thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority. Airmode is used to keep torque authority with zero thrust (see MC_AIRMODE).

MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX.short: Maximal tilt angle in Stabilized or Altitude mode.

MPC_MAN_Y_MAX.short: Max manual yaw rate for Stabilized, Altitude, Position mode.

MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.short: Manual yaw rate input filter time constant.
MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.long: Not used in Stabilized mode Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter

MPC_POS_MODE.long: The supported sub-modes are: Direct velocity: Sticks directly map to velocity setpoints without smoothing. Also applies to vertical direction and Altitude mode. Useful for velocity control tuning. Acceleration based: Sticks map to acceleration and there's a virtual brake drag

MPC_THR_CURVE.short: Thrust curve mapping in Stabilized Mode.
MPC_THR_CURVE.long: Defines how the throttle stick is mapped to collective thrust in Stabilized mode. Rescale to hover thrust estimate: Stick input is linearly rescaled, such that a centered throttle stick corresponds to the hover thrust estimator's output. No rescale: Directly map the stick 1:1 to the output. Can be useful with very low hover thrust which leads to much distortion and the upper half getting sensitive. Rescale to hover thrust parameter: Similar to rescaling to the hover thrust estimate, but it uses the hover thrust parameter value (see MPC_THR_HOVER) instead of estimated value. With MPC_THR_HOVER 0.5 it's equivalent to No rescale.

MPC_THR_HOVER.long: Mapped to center throttle stick in Stabilized mode (see MPC_THR_CURVE). Used for initialization of the hover thrust estimator (see MPC_USE_HTE). The estimated hover thrust is used as base for zero vertical acceleration in altitude control. The hover thrust is important for land detection to work correctly.

MPC_THR_MAX.short: Maximum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes.
MPC_THR_MAX.long: Limit allowed thrust e.g. for indoor test of overpowered vehicle.

MPC_THR_MIN.short: Minimum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes.
MPC_THR_MIN.long: Too low thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority. With airmode enabled this parameters can be set to 0 while still keeping torque authority (see MC_AIRMODE).

MPC_THR_XY_MARG.long: Margin that is kept for horizontal control when higher priority vertical thrust is saturated. To avoid completely starving horizontal control with high vertical error.

MPC_TILTMAX_AIR.long: Absolute maximum for all velocity or acceleration controlled modes. Any higher value is truncated.

MPC_TILTMAX_LND.short: Maximum tilt during inital takeoff ramp.
MPC_TILTMAX_LND.long: Tighter tilt limit during takeoff to avoid tip over.

MPC_TKO_RAMP_T.long: Increasing this value will make climb rate controlled takeoff slower. If it's too slow the drone might scratch the ground and tip over. A time constant of 0 disables the ramp

MPC_USE_HTE.long: Disable to use the fixed parameter MPC_THR_HOVER. Enable to use the hover thrust estimator. This parameter does not influence Stabilized mode throttle curve (see MPC_THR_CURVE).

MPC_VELD_LP.short: Velocity derivative low pass cutoff frequency.
MPC_VELD_LP.long: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_LP.long: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_MANUAL.short: Maximum horizontal velocity setpoint in Position mode.
MPC_VEL_MANUAL.long: Must be smaller than MPC_XY_VEL_MAX. The maximum sideways and backward speed can be set differently using MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE and MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK, respectively.

MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK.short: Maximum backward velocity in Position mode.
MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK.long: If set to a negative value or larger than MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE.short: Maximum sideways velocity in Position mode.
MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE.long: If set to a negative value or larger than MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.

MPC_VEL_NF_BW.long: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_NF_FRQ.long: The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the velocity. A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_XY_CRUISE.short: Default horizontal velocity in autonomous modes.
MPC_XY_CRUISE.long: e.g. in Missions, RTL, Goto if the waypoint does not specify differently

MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.short: Maximum horizontal error allowed by the trajectory generator.
MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.long: The integration speed of the trajectory setpoint is linearly reduced with the horizontal position tracking error. When the error is above this parameter, the integration of the trajectory is stopped to wait for the drone. This value can be adjusted depending on the tracking capabilities of the vehicle.

MPC_XY_MAN_EXPO.short: Manual position control stick exponential curve sensitivity.
MPC_XY_MAN_EXPO.long: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MPC_XY_P.short: Proportional gain for horizontal position error.
MPC_XY_P.long: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

MPC_XY_TRAJ_P.short: Proportional gain for horizontal trajectory position error.

MPC_XY_VEL_ALL.long: If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as MPC_XY_VEL_MAX or MPC_VEL_MANUAL). If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.short: Differential gain for horizontal velocity error.
MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.short: Integral gain for horizontal velocity error.
MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.long: Defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral Allows to eliminate steady state errors in disturbances like wind.

MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.long: Absolute maximum for all velocity controlled modes. Any higher value is truncated.

MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.short: Proportional gain for horizontal velocity error.
MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

MPC_YAW_EXPO.short: Manual control stick yaw rotation exponential curve.
MPC_YAW_EXPO.long: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MPC_Z_MAN_EXPO.short: Manual control stick vertical exponential curve.
MPC_Z_MAN_EXPO.long: The higher the value the less sensitivity the stick has around zero while still reaching the maximum value with full stick deflection. 0 Purely linear input curve 1 Purely cubic input curve

MPC_Z_P.short: Proportional gain for vertical position error.
MPC_Z_P.long: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error

MPC_Z_VEL_ALL.long: If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP or MPC_LAND_SPEED). If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.short: Differential gain for vertical velocity error.
MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.short: Integral gain for vertical velocity error.
MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN.long: Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes. In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity. For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP.long: Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes. In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity. For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.short: Proportional gain for vertical velocity error.
MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.long: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN.long: For manual modes and offboard, see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN

MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP.long: For manually controlled modes and offboard see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP

SYS_VEHICLE_RESP.long: Changes the overall responsiveness of the vehicle. The higher the value, the faster the vehicle will react. If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as the acceleration or jerk limits). If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

WV_ROLL_MIN.short: Minimum roll angle setpoint for weathervane controller to demand a yaw-rate.

WV_YRATE_MAX.short: Maximum yawrate the weathervane controller is allowed to demand.

MC_SLOW_DEF_HVEL.long: This value is used in slow mode if no aux channel is mapped and no limit is commanded through MAVLink.

MC_SLOW_DEF_VVEL.long: This value is used in slow mode if no aux channel is mapped and no limit is commanded through MAVLink.

MC_SLOW_DEF_YAWR.long: This value is used in slow mode if no aux channel is mapped and no limit is commanded through MAVLink.

MC_SLOW_MAP_HVEL.short: Manual input mapped to scale horizontal velocity in position slow mode.

MC_SLOW_MAP_PTCH.short: RC_MAP_AUX{N} to allow for gimbal pitch rate control in position slow mode.

MC_SLOW_MAP_VVEL.short: Manual input mapped to scale vertical velocity in position slow mode.

MC_SLOW_MAP_YAWR.short: Manual input mapped to scale yaw rate in position slow mode.

MC_SLOW_MIN_HVEL.long: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this velocity.

MC_SLOW_MIN_VVEL.long: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this velocity.

MC_SLOW_MIN_YAWR.long: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this rate.

MC_BAT_SCALE_EN.long: This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to normalize performance across the operating range of the battery. The copter should constantly behave as if it was fully charged with reduced max acceleration at lower battery percentages. i.e. if hover is at 0.5 throttle at 100% battery, it will still be 0.5 at 60% battery.

MC_PITCHRATE_D.long: Pitch rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_PITCHRATE_I.long: Pitch rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_PITCHRATE_K.long: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = MC_PITCHRATE_K * (MC_PITCHRATE_P * error + MC_PITCHRATE_I * error_integral + MC_PITCHRATE_D * error_derivative) Set MC_PITCHRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set MC_PITCHRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_PITCHRATE_P.long: Pitch rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_PR_INT_LIM.long: Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large pitch moment trim changes.

MC_ROLLRATE_D.long: Roll rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_ROLLRATE_I.long: Roll rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_ROLLRATE_K.long: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = MC_ROLLRATE_K * (MC_ROLLRATE_P * error + MC_ROLLRATE_I * error_integral + MC_ROLLRATE_D * error_derivative) Set MC_ROLLRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set MC_ROLLRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_ROLLRATE_P.long: Roll rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_RR_INT_LIM.long: Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large roll moment trim changes.

MC_YAWRATE_D.long: Yaw rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_YAWRATE_I.long: Yaw rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_YAWRATE_K.long: Global gain of the controller. This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller: output = MC_YAWRATE_K * (MC_YAWRATE_P * error + MC_YAWRATE_I * error_integral + MC_YAWRATE_D * error_derivative) Set MC_YAWRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form. Set MC_YAWRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_YAWRATE_P.long: Yaw rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF.short: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for yaw torque setpoint.
MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF.long: Reduces vibrations by lowering high frequency torque caused by rotor acceleration. 0 disables the filter

MC_YR_INT_LIM.long: Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large yaw moment trim changes.

MSP_OSD_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run MSP OSD.

OSD_ATXXXX_CFG.long: Configure the ATXXXX OSD Chip (mounted on the OmnibusF4SD board) and select the transmission standard.

OSD_CH_HEIGHT.long: Controls the vertical position of the crosshair display. Resolution is limited by OSD to 15 discrete values. Negative values will display the crosshairs below the horizon

OSD_DWELL_TIME.long: Amount of time in milliseconds to dwell at the beginning of the display, when scrolling.

OSD_LOG_LEVEL.long: Minimum security of log level to display on the OSD.

OSD_SCROLL_RATE.long: Scroll rate in milliseconds for OSD messages longer than available character width. This is lower-bounded by the nominal loop rate of this module.

PWM_SBUS_MODE.long: Set to 1 to enable S.BUS version 1 output instead of RSSI.

THR_MDL_FAC.short: Thrust to motor control signal model parameter.
THR_MDL_FAC.long: Parameter used to model the nonlinear relationship between motor control signal (e.g. PWM) and static thrust. The model is: rel_thrust = factor * rel_signal^2 + (1-factor) * rel_signal, where rel_thrust is the normalized thrust between 0 and 1, and rel_signal is the relative motor control signal between 0 and 1.

PD_GRIPPER_EN.short: Enable Gripper actuation in Payload Deliverer.

PD_GRIPPER_TO.short: Timeout for successful gripper actuation acknowledgement.
PD_GRIPPER_TO.long: Maximum time Gripper will wait while the successful griper actuation isn't recognised. If the gripper has no feedback sensor, it will simply wait for this time before considering gripper actuation successful and publish a 'VehicleCommandAck' signaling successful gripper action

PLD_BTOUT.long: Time after which the landing target is considered lost without any new measurements.

PLD_FAPPR_ALT.long: Allow final approach (without horizontal positioning) if losing landing target closer than this to the ground.

PLD_HACC_RAD.long: Start descending if closer above landing target than this.

PLD_MAX_SRCH.long: Maximum number of times to search for the landing target if it is lost during the precision landing.

PLD_SRCH_ALT.long: Altitude above home to which to climb when searching for the landing target.

PLD_SRCH_TOUT.long: Time allowed to search for the landing target before falling back to normal landing.

PP_LOOKAHD_GAIN.short: Tuning parameter for the pure pursuit controller.
PP_LOOKAHD_GAIN.long: Lower value -> More aggressive controller (beware overshoot/oscillations)

PP_LOOKAHD_MAX.short: Maximum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller.

PP_LOOKAHD_MIN.short: Minimum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller.

RC_INPUT_PROTO.long: Select your RC input protocol or auto to scan.

RC10_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC11_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC12_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC13_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC14_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC15_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC16_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC17_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC18_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC1_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC2_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC3_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC4_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC5_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC6_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC7_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC8_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC9_DZ.long: The +- range of this value around the trim value will be considered as zero.

RC_CHAN_CNT.long: This parameter is used by Ground Station software to save the number of channels which were used during RC calibration. It is only meant for ground station use.

RC_FAILS_THR.long: Use RC_MAP_FAILSAFE to specify which channel is used to indicate RC loss via this threshold. By default this is the throttle channel. Set to a PWM value slightly above the PWM value for the channel (e.g. throttle) in a failsafe event, but below the minimum PWM value for the channel during normal operation. Note: The default value of 0 disables the feature (it is below the expected range).

RC_MAP_ENG_MOT.short: RC channel to engage the main motor (for helicopters).

RC_MAP_FAILSAFE.long: Configures which RC channel is used by the receiver to indicate the signal was lost (on receivers that use output a fixed signal value to report lost signal). If set to 0, the channel mapped to throttle is used. Use RC_FAILS_THR to set the threshold indicating lost signal. By default it's below the expected range and hence disabled.

RC_MAP_PARAM1.long: Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 1st parameter channel. Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM2.long: Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 2nd parameter channel. Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM3.long: Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 3th parameter channel. Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PITCH.long: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading pitch inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_ROLL.long: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading roll inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_THROTTLE.long: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading throttle inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_YAW.long: The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for reading yaw inputs from. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_RSSI_PWM_CHAN.short: PWM input channel that provides RSSI.
RC_RSSI_PWM_CHAN.long: 0: do not read RSSI from input channel 1-18: read RSSI from specified input channel Specify the range for RSSI input with RC_RSSI_PWM_MIN and RC_RSSI_PWM_MAX parameters.

RC_RSSI_PWM_MAX.short: Max input value for RSSI reading.

RC_RSSI_PWM_MIN.short: Min input value for RSSI reading.

TRIM_PITCH.long: The trim value is the actuator control value the system needs for straight and level flight.

TRIM_ROLL.long: The trim value is the actuator control value the system needs for straight and level flight.

TRIM_YAW.long: The trim value is the actuator control value the system needs for straight and level flight.

RC_ARMSWITCH_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_ENG_MOT_TH.short: Threshold for selecting main motor engage.
RC_ENG_MOT_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_GEAR_TH.short: Threshold for the landing gear switch.
RC_GEAR_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_KILLSWITCH_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_LOITER_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_MAP_ARM_SW.long: Use it to arm/disarm via switch instead of default throttle stick. If this is assigned, arming and disarming via stick is disabled.

RC_MAP_FLTMODE.long: If this parameter is non-zero, flight modes are only selected by this channel and are assigned to six slots.

RC_MAP_FLTM_BTN.long: This bitmask allows to specify multiple channels for changing flight modes using momentary buttons. Each channel is assigned to a mode slot ((lowest channel = slot 1). The resulting modes for each slot X is defined by the COM_FLTMODEX parameters. The functionality can be used only if RC_MAP_FLTMODE is disabled. The maximum number of available slots and hence bits set in the mask is 6.

bits.0: Mask Channel 1 as a mode button
bits.1: Mask Channel 2 as a mode button
bits.2: Mask Channel 3 as a mode button
bits.3: Mask Channel 4 as a mode button
bits.4: Mask Channel 5 as a mode button
bits.5: Mask Channel 6 as a mode button
bits.6: Mask Channel 7 as a mode button
bits.7: Mask Channel 8 as a mode button
bits.8: Mask Channel 9 as a mode button
bits.9: Mask Channel 10 as a mode button
bits.10: Mask Channel 11 as a mode button
bits.11: Mask Channel 12 as a mode button
bits.12: Mask Channel 13 as a mode button
bits.13: Mask Channel 14 as a mode button
bits.14: Mask Channel 15 as a mode button
bits.15: Mask Channel 16 as a mode button
bits.16: Mask Channel 17 as a mode button
bits.17: Mask Channel 18 as a mode button

RC_MAP_MODE_SW.long: This is the main flight mode selector. The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates which channel should be used for deciding about the main mode. A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_OFFB_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_PAYLOAD_TH.short: Threshold for selecting payload power switch.
RC_PAYLOAD_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_RETURN_TH.short: Threshold for selecting return to launch mode.
RC_RETURN_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RC_TRANS_TH.short: Threshold for the VTOL transition switch.
RC_TRANS_TH.long: 0-1 indicate where in the full channel range the threshold sits 0 : min 1 : max sign indicates polarity of comparison positive : true when channel>th negative : true when channel<th

RTL_CONE_ANG.short: Half-angle of the return mode altitude cone.
RTL_CONE_ANG.long: Defines the half-angle of a cone centered around the destination position that affects the altitude at which the vehicle returns.

values.0: No cone, always climb to RTL_RETURN_ALT above destination.
values.90: Only climb to at least RTL_DESCEND_ALT above destination.

RTL_DESCEND_ALT.long: Descend to this altitude (above destination position) after return, and wait for time defined in RTL_LAND_DELAY. Land (i.e. slowly descend) from this altitude if autolanding allowed. VTOLs do transition to hover in this altitdue above the landing point.

RTL_LAND_DELAY.long: Delay before landing (after initial descent) in Return mode. If set to -1 the system will not land but loiter at RTL_DESCEND_ALT.

RTL_LOITER_RAD.long: Set the radius for loitering to a safe altitude for VTOL transition.

RTL_MIN_DIST.short: Horizontal radius from return point within which special rules for return mode apply.
RTL_MIN_DIST.long: The return altitude will be calculated based on RTL_CONE_ANG parameter. The yaw setpoint will switch to the one defined by corresponding waypoint.

RTL_PLD_MD.long: Use precision landing when doing an RTL landing phase. This setting does not apply for RTL destinations planned as part of a mission.

RTL_RETURN_ALT.long: Default minimum altitude above destination (e.g. home, safe point, landing pattern) for return flight. The vehicle will climb to this altitude when Return mode is enganged, unless it currently is flying higher already. This is affected by RTL_MIN_DIST and RTL_CONE_ANG.

RTL_TYPE.long: Return mode destination and flight path (home location, rally point, mission landing pattern, reverse mission)

values.0: Return to closest safe point (home or rally point) via direct path.
values.1: Return to closest safe point other than home (mission landing pattern or rally point), via direct path. If no mission landing or rally points are defined return home via direct path. Always chose closest safe landing point if vehicle is a VTOL in hover mode.
values.2: Return to a planned mission landing, if available, using the mission path, else return to home via the reverse mission path. Do not consider rally points.
values.3: Return via direct path to closest destination: home, start of mission landing pattern or safe point. If the destination is a mission landing pattern, follow the pattern to land.

RTL_APPR_FORCE.long: Only consider RTL point, if it has an approach defined.

RTL_TIME_FACTOR.short: RTL time estimate safety margin factor.
RTL_TIME_FACTOR.long: Safety factor that is used to scale the actual RTL time estimate. Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

RTL_TIME_MARGIN.short: RTL time estimate safety margin offset.
RTL_TIME_MARGIN.long: Margin that is added to the time estimate, after it has already been scaled Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

RBCLW_SER_CFG.long: Configure on which serial port to run Roboclaw Driver.

RBCLW_ADDRESS.short: Address of the ESC on the bus.
RBCLW_ADDRESS.long: The ESC has to be configured to have an address from 0x80 to 0x87. This parameter needs to match the configured value.

RBCLW_COUNTS_REV.short: Number of encoder counts for one wheel revolution.
RBCLW_COUNTS_REV.long: The default value of 1200 corresponds to the default configuration of the Aion R1 rover.

RA_ACC_RAD_GAIN.long: The geometric ideal acceptance radius is multiplied by this factor to account for kinematic and dynamic effects. Higher value -> The rover starts to cut the corner earlier.

RA_ACC_RAD_MAX.short: Maximum acceptance radius for the waypoints.
RA_ACC_RAD_MAX.long: The controller scales the acceptance radius based on the angle between the previous, current and next waypoint. Higher value -> smoother trajectory at the cost of how close the rover gets to the waypoint (Set to -1 to disable corner cutting).

RA_WHEEL_BASE.long: Distance from the front to the rear axle.

RO_YAW_P.short: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw controller.

RD_MAX_THR_YAW_R.short: Yaw rate turning left/right wheels at max speed in opposite directions.
RD_MAX_THR_YAW_R.long: This parameter is used to calculate the feedforward term of the closed loop yaw rate control. The controller first calculates the required speed difference between the left and right motor to achieve the desired yaw rate. This desired speed difference is then linearly mapped to normalized motor commands. A good starting point is half the speed the rover drives at maximum throttle (RD_MAX_THR_SPD)). Increase this parameter if the rover turns faster than the setpoint, and decrease if the rover turns slower.

RD_MISS_SPD_GAIN.short: Tuning parameter for the speed reduction during waypoint transition.
RD_MISS_SPD_GAIN.long: The waypoint transition speed is calculated as: Transition_speed = Maximum_speed * (1 - normalized_transition_angle * RM_MISS_VEL_GAIN) The normalized transition angle is the angle between the line segment from prev-curr WP and curr-next WP interpolated from [0, 180] -> [0, 1]. Higher value -> More speed reduction during waypoint transitions. Set to -1 to disable any speed reduction during waypoint transition.

RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN.short: Yaw error threshhold to switch from driving to spot turning.
RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN.long: This threshold is used for the state machine to switch from driving to turning based on the error between the desired and actual yaw. It is also used as the threshold whether the rover should come to a smooth stop at the next waypoint. This slow down effect is active if the angle between the line segments from prevWP-currWP and currWP-nextWP is smaller then 180 - RD_TRANS_DRV_TRN.

RD_TRANS_TRN_DRV.short: Yaw error threshhold to switch from spot turning to driving.
RD_TRANS_TRN_DRV.long: This threshold is used for the state machine to switch from turning to driving based on the error between the desired and actual yaw.

RD_WHEEL_TRACK.long: Distance from the center of the right wheel to the center of the left wheel.

RM_COURSE_CTL_TH.short: Threshold to update course control in manual position mode.
RM_COURSE_CTL_TH.long: Threshold for the angle between the active cruise direction and the cruise direction given by the stick inputs. This can be understood as a deadzone for the combined stick inputs for forward/backwards and lateral speed which defines a course direction.

RM_MAX_THR_YAW_R.short: Yaw rate turning left/right wheels at max speed in opposite directions.
RM_MAX_THR_YAW_R.long: This parameter is used to calculate the feedforward term of the closed loop yaw rate control. The controller first calculates the required speed difference between the left and right motor to achieve the desired yaw rate. This desired speed difference is then linearly mapped to normalized motor commands. A good starting point is half the speed the rover drives at maximum throttle (RD_MAX_THR_SPD)). Increase this parameter if the rover turns faster than the setpoint, and decrease if the rover turns slower.

RM_MISS_SPD_GAIN.short: Tuning parameter for the speed reduction during waypoint transition.
RM_MISS_SPD_GAIN.long: The waypoint transition speed is calculated as: Transition_speed = Maximum_speed * (1 - normalized_transition_angle * RM_MISS_VEL_GAIN) The normalized transition angle is the angle between the line segment from prev-curr waypoint and curr-next waypoint interpolated from [0, 180] -> [0, 1]. Higher value -> More speed reduction during waypoint transitions. Set to -1 to disable any speed reduction during waypoint transition.

RM_WHEEL_TRACK.long: Distance from the center of the right wheel to the center of the left wheel.

GND_L1_DIST.long: This is the distance at which the next waypoint is activated. This should be set to about 2-4x of GND_WHEEL_BASE and not smaller than one meter (due to GPS accuracy).

GND_L1_PERIOD.long: This is the L1 distance and defines the tracking point ahead of the rover it's following. Use values around 2-5m for a 0.3m wheel base. Tuning instructions: Shorten slowly during tuning until response is sharp without oscillation.

GND_MAX_ANG.short: Maximum turn angle for Ackerman steering.
GND_MAX_ANG.long: At a control output of 0, the steering wheels are at 0 radians. At a control output of 1, the steering wheels are at GND_MAX_ANG radians.

GND_SPEED_D.long: This is the derivative gain for the speed closed loop controller

GND_SPEED_I.long: This is the integral gain for the speed closed loop controller

GND_SPEED_IMAX.long: This is the maxim value the integral can reach to prevent wind-up.

GND_SPEED_P.long: This is the proportional gain for the speed closed loop controller

GND_SPEED_THR_SC.long: This is a gain to map the speed control output to the throttle linearly.

GND_SP_CTRL_MODE.long: This allows the user to choose between closed loop gps speed or open loop cruise throttle speed

values.1: close the loop with gps speed

GND_THR_CRUISE.long: This is the throttle setting required to achieve the desired cruise speed. 10% is ok for a traxxas stampede vxl with ESC set to training mode

GND_THR_MAX.long: This is the maximum throttle % that can be used by the controller. For a Traxxas stampede vxl with the ESC set to training, 30 % is enough

GND_THR_MIN.long: This is the minimum throttle % that can be used by the controller. Set to 0 for rover

GND_WHEEL_BASE.short: Distance from front axle to rear axle.
GND_WHEEL_BASE.long: A value of 0.31 is typical for 1/10 RC cars.

RO_YAW_ACCEL_LIM.long: Used to cap how quickly the magnitude of yaw rate setpoints can increase. Set to -1 to disable.

RO_YAW_DECEL_LIM.long: Used to cap how quickly the magnitude of yaw rate setpoints can decrease. Set to -1 to disable.

RO_YAW_RATE_I.short: Integral gain for closed loop yaw rate controller.

RO_YAW_RATE_LIM.long: Used to cap yaw rate setpoints and map controller inputs to yaw rate setpoints in Acro, Stabilized and Position mode.

RO_YAW_RATE_P.short: Proportional gain for closed loop yaw rate controller.

RO_YAW_RATE_TH.long: The minimum threshold for the yaw rate measurement not to be interpreted as zero.

RO_YAW_STICK_DZ.long: Percentage of stick input range that will be interpreted as zero around the stick centered value.

RO_ACCEL_LIM.long: Set to -1 to disable. For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral acceleration.

RO_DECEL_LIM.long: Set to -1 to disable. Note that if it is disabled the rover will not slow down when approaching waypoints in auto modes. For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral deceleration.

RO_JERK_LIM.long: Set to -1 to disable. Note that if it is disabled the rover will not slow down when approaching waypoints in auto modes. For mecanum rovers this limit is used for longitudinal and lateral jerk.

RO_MAX_THR_SPEED.short: Speed the rover drives at maximum throttle.
RO_MAX_THR_SPEED.long: Used to linearly map speeds [m/s] to throttle values [-1. 1].

RO_SPEED_I.short: Integral gain for ground speed controller.

RO_SPEED_LIM.long: Used to cap speed setpoints and map controller inputs to speed setpoints in Position mode.

RO_SPEED_P.short: Proportional gain for ground speed controller.

RO_SPEED_TH.long: Set to -1 to disable. The minimum threshold for the speed measurement not to be interpreted as zero.

RWTO_HDG.short: Specifies which heading should be held during the runway takeoff ground roll.
RWTO_HDG.long: 0: airframe heading when takeoff is initiated 1: position control along runway direction (bearing defined from vehicle position on takeoff initiation to MAV_CMD_TAKEOFF position defined by operator)

RWTO_NPFG_PERIOD.short: NPFG period while steering on runway.

RWTO_NUDGE.short: Enable use of yaw stick for nudging the wheel during runway ground roll.
RWTO_NUDGE.long: This is useful when map, GNSS, or yaw errors on ground are misaligned with what the operator intends for takeoff course. Particularly useful for skinny runways or if the wheel servo is a bit off trim.

RWTO_PSP.short: Pitch setpoint during taxi / before takeoff rotation airspeed is reached.
RWTO_PSP.long: A taildragger with steerable wheel might need to pitch up a little to keep its wheel on the ground before airspeed to takeoff is reached.

RWTO_RAMP_TIME.short: Throttle ramp up time for runway takeoff.

RWTO_ROT_AIRSPD.long: The calibrated airspeed threshold during the takeoff ground roll when the plane should start rotating (pitching up). Must be less than the takeoff airspeed, will otherwise be capped at the takeoff airpeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD). If set <= 0.0, defaults to 0.9 * takeoff airspeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD)

RWTO_ROT_TIME.long: This is the time desired to linearly ramp in takeoff pitch constraints during the takeoff rotation

SDLOG_ALGORITHM.long: Selects the algorithm used for logfile encryption

SDLOG_BOOT_BAT.long: When enabled, logging will not start from boot if battery power is not detected (e.g. powered via USB on a test bench). This prevents extraneous flight logs from being created during bench testing. Note that this only applies to log-from-boot modes. This has no effect on arm-based modes.

SDLOG_DIRS_MAX.short: Maximum number of log directories to keep.
SDLOG_DIRS_MAX.long: If there are more log directories than this value, the system will delete the oldest directories during startup. In addition, the system will delete old logs if there is not enough free space left. The minimum amount is 300 MB. If this is set to 0, old directories will only be removed if the free space falls below the minimum. Note: this does not apply to mission log files.

SDLOG_EXCH_KEY.long: If the logfile is encrypted using a symmetric key algorithm, the used encryption key is generated at logging start and stored on the sdcard RSA2048 encrypted using this key.

SDLOG_KEY.long: Selects the key in keystore, used for encrypting the log. When using a symmetric encryption algorithm, the key is generated at logging start and kept stored in this index. For symmetric algorithms, the key is volatile and valid only for the duration of logging. The key is stored in encrypted format on the sdcard alongside the logfile, using an RSA2048 key defined by the SDLOG_EXCHANGE_KEY

SDLOG_MISSION.long: If enabled, a small additional "mission" log file will be written to the SD card. The log contains just those messages that are useful for tasks like generating flight statistics and geotagging. The different modes can be used to further reduce the logged data (and thus the log file size). For example, choose geotagging mode to only log data required for geotagging. Note that the normal/full log is still created, and contains all the data in the mission log (and more).

SDLOG_MODE.long: Determines when to start and stop logging. By default, logging is started when arming the system, and stopped when disarming.

SDLOG_PROFILE.long: This integer bitmask controls the set and rates of logged topics. The default allows for general log analysis while keeping the log file size reasonably small. Enabling multiple sets leads to higher bandwidth requirements and larger log files. Set bits true to enable: 0 : Default set (used for general log analysis) 1 : Full rate estimator (EKF2) replay topics 2 : Topics for thermal calibration (high rate raw IMU and Baro sensor data) 3 : Topics for system identification (high rate actuator control and IMU data) 4 : Full rates for analysis of fast maneuvers (RC, attitude, rates and actuators) 5 : Debugging topics (debug_*.msg topics, for custom code) 6 : Topics for sensor comparison (low rate raw IMU, Baro and magnetometer data) 7 : Topics for computer vision and collision prevention 8 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Gyro) 9 : Raw FIFO high-rate IMU (Accel) 10: Logging of mavlink tunnel message (useful for payload communication debugging)

SDLOG_UTC_OFFSET.long: the difference in hours and minutes from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) for a your place and date. for example, In case of South Korea(UTC+09:00), UTC offset is 540 min (9*60) refer to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UTC_time_offsets

SDLOG_UUID.long: If set to 1, add an ID to the log, which uniquely identifies the vehicle

SIM_BAT_ENABLE.long: Enable or disable the internal battery simulation. This is useful when the battery is simulated externally and interfaced with PX4 through MAVLink for example.

SIM_BAT_MIN_PCT.long: Can be used to alter the battery level during SITL- or HITL-simulation on the fly. Particularly useful for testing different low-battery behaviour.
