SENS_DPRES_ANSC.long: Pick the appropriate scaling from the datasheet. this number defines the (linear) conversion from voltage to Pascal (pa). For the MPXV7002DP this is 1000. NOTE: If the sensor always registers zero, try switching the static and dynamic tubes.

SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT.short: Maximum height above ground when reliant on optical flow.
SENS_FLOW_MAXHGT.long: This parameter defines the maximum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably. The height setpoint will be limited to be no greater than this value when the navigation system is completely reliant on optical flow data and the height above ground estimate is valid. The sensor may be usable above this height, but accuracy will progressively degrade.

SENS_FLOW_MAXR.short: Magnitude of maximum angular flow rate reliably measurable by the optical flow sensor.
SENS_FLOW_MAXR.long: Optical flow data will not fused by the estimators if the magnitude of the flow rate exceeds this value and control loops will be instructed to limit ground speed such that the flow rate produced by movement over ground is less than 50% of this value.

SENS_FLOW_MINHGT.short: Minimum height above ground when reliant on optical flow.
SENS_FLOW_MINHGT.long: This parameter defines the minimum distance from ground at which the optical flow sensor operates reliably. The sensor may be usable below this height, but accuracy will progressively reduce to loss of focus.

ADC_ADS1115_EN.long: If enabled, the internal ADC is not used.

BAT1_C_MULT.short: Capacity/current multiplier for high-current capable SMBUS battery.

CAL_AIR_CMODEL.short: Airspeed sensor compensation model for the SDP3x.
CAL_AIR_CMODEL.long: Model with Pitot CAL_AIR_TUBED_MM: Not used, 1.5 mm tubes assumed. CAL_AIR_TUBELEN: Length of the tubes connecting the pitot to the sensor. Model without Pitot (1.5 mm tubes) CAL_AIR_TUBED_MM: Not used, 1.5 mm tubes assumed. CAL_AIR_TUBELEN: Length of the tubes connecting the pitot to the sensor. Tube Pressure Drop CAL_AIR_TUBED_MM: Diameter in mm of the pitot and tubes, must have the same diameter. CAL_AIR_TUBELEN: Length of the tubes connecting the pitot to the sensor and the static + dynamic port length of the pitot.

CAL_AIR_TUBED_MM.short: Airspeed sensor tube diameter. Only used for the Tube Pressure Drop Compensation.

CAL_AIR_TUBELEN.long: See the CAL_AIR_CMODEL explanation on how this parameter should be set.

IMU_ACCEL_CUTOFF.short: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for accel.
IMU_ACCEL_CUTOFF.long: The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary accelerometer. This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators. 0 disables the filter.

IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF.short: Cutoff frequency for angular acceleration (D-Term filter).
IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF.long: The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter used on the time derivative of the measured angular velocity, also known as the D-term filter in the rate controller. The D-term uses the derivative of the rate and thus is the most susceptible to noise. Therefore, using a D-term filter allows to increase IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF, which leads to reduced control latency and permits to increase the P gains. A value of 0 disables the filter.

IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF.short: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for gyro.
IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF.long: The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary gyro. This only affects the angular velocity sent to the controllers, not the estimators. It applies also to the angular acceleration (D-Term filter), see IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF. A value of 0 disables the filter.

IMU_GYRO_DNF_BW.short: IMU gyro ESC notch filter bandwidth.
IMU_GYRO_DNF_BW.long: Bandwidth per notch filter when using dynamic notch filtering with ESC RPM.

IMU_GYRO_DNF_EN.long: Enable bank of dynamically updating notch filters. Requires ESC RPM feedback or onboard FFT (IMU_GYRO_FFT_EN).

IMU_GYRO_DNF_HMC.short: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter harmonics.
IMU_GYRO_DNF_HMC.long: ESC RPM number of harmonics (multiples of RPM) for ESC RPM dynamic notch filtering.

IMU_GYRO_DNF_MIN.short: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter minimum frequency.
IMU_GYRO_DNF_MIN.long: Minimum notch filter frequency in Hz.

IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW.long: The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro. See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency. Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ.long: The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro. This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency. This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators. Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers. See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter. A value of 0 disables the filter.

IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW.long: The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro. See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency. Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ.long: The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro. This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency. This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators. Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers. See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter. A value of 0 disables the filter.

IMU_GYRO_RATEMAX.short: Gyro control data maximum publication rate (inner loop rate).
IMU_GYRO_RATEMAX.long: The maximum rate the gyro control data (vehicle_angular_velocity) will be allowed to publish at. This is the loop rate for the rate controller and outputs. Note: sensor data is always read and filtered at the full raw rate (eg commonly 8 kHz) regardless of this setting.

IMU_INTEG_RATE.long: The rate at which raw IMU data is integrated to produce delta angles and delta velocities. Recommended to set this to a multiple of the estimator update period (currently 10 ms for ekf2).

INA220_CUR_BAT.short: INA220 Power Monitor Battery Max Current.

INA220_CUR_REG.short: INA220 Power Monitor Regulator Max Current.

PCF8583_MAGNET.long: Nmumber of signals per rotation of actuator

PCF8583_POOL.long: Determines how often the sensor is read out.

PCF8583_RESET.long: Internal device counter is reset to 0 when overrun this value, counter is able to store up to 6 digits reset of counter takes some time - measurement with reset has worse accuracy. 0 means reset counter after every measurement.

SENS_AFBR_HYSTER.short: AFBR Rangefinder Short/Long Range Threshold Hysteresis.
SENS_AFBR_HYSTER.long: This parameter defines the hysteresis for switching between short and long range mode.

SENS_AFBR_L_RATE.long: This parameter defines measurement rate of the AFBR Rangefinder in long range mode.

SENS_AFBR_MODE.long: This parameter defines the mode of the AFBR Rangefinder.

SENS_AFBR_S_RATE.long: This parameter defines measurement rate of the AFBR Rangefinder in short range mode.

SENS_AFBR_THRESH.long: This parameter defines the threshold for switching between short and long range mode. The mode will switch from short to long range when the distance is greater than the threshold plus the hysteresis. The mode will switch from long to short range when the distance is less than the threshold minus the hysteresis.

SENS_BARO_RATE.long: Barometric air data maximum publication rate. This is an upper bound, actual barometric data rate is still dependent on the sensor.

SENS_BOARD_ROT.long: This parameter defines the rotation of the FMU board relative to the platform.

SENS_BOARD_X_OFF.long: This parameter defines a rotational offset in degrees around the X (Roll) axis It allows the user to fine tune the board offset in the event of misalignment.

SENS_BOARD_Y_OFF.long: This parameter defines a rotational offset in degrees around the Y (Pitch) axis. It allows the user to fine tune the board offset in the event of misalignment.

SENS_BOARD_Z_OFF.long: This parameter defines a rotational offset in degrees around the Z (Yaw) axis. It allows the user to fine tune the board offset in the event of misalignment.

SEP_AUTO_CONFIG.long: By default, the receiver is automatically configured. Sometimes it may be used for multiple purposes. If the offered parameters aren't sufficient, this parameter can be disabled to have full control of the receiver configuration. A good way to use this is to enable automatic configuration, let the receiver be configured, and then disable it to make manual adjustments.

SEP_CONST_USAGE.long: Choice of which constellations the receiver should use for PVT computation. When this is 0, the constellation usage isn't changed.

SEP_DUMP_COMM.long: Log raw communication between the driver and connected receivers. For example, "To receiver" will log all commands and corrections sent by the driver to the receiver.

SEP_HARDW_SETUP.short: Setup and expected use of the hardware.
SEP_HARDW_SETUP.long: - Default: Use two receivers as completely separate instances. - Moving base: Use two receivers in a rover & moving base setup for heading.

SEP_LOG_FORCE.short: Whether to overwrite or add to existing logging.
SEP_LOG_FORCE.long: When the receiver is already set up to log data, this decides whether extra logged data should be added or overwrite existing data.

SEP_LOG_HZ.long: Select the frequency at which the connected receiver should log data to its internal storage.

SEP_LOG_LEVEL.long: Select the level of detail that needs to be logged by the receiver.

SEP_OUTP_HZ.short: Output frequency of main SBF blocks.
SEP_OUTP_HZ.long: The output frequency of the main SBF blocks needed for PVT information.

SEP_PITCH_OFFS.short: Pitch offset for dual antenna GPS.
SEP_PITCH_OFFS.long: Vertical offsets can be compensated for by adjusting the Pitch offset. Note that this can be interpreted as the "roll" angle in case the antennas are aligned along the perpendicular axis. This occurs in situations where the two antenna ARPs may not be exactly at the same height in the vehicle reference frame. Since pitch is defined as the right-handed rotation about the vehicle Y axis, a situation where the main antenna is mounted lower than the aux antenna (assuming the default antenna setup) will result in a positive pitch.

SEP_STREAM_LOG.short: Logging stream used during automatic configuration.
SEP_STREAM_LOG.long: The stream the autopilot sets up on the receiver to output the logging data. Set this to another value if the default stream is already used for another purpose.

SEP_STREAM_MAIN.short: Main stream used during automatic configuration.
SEP_STREAM_MAIN.long: The stream the autopilot sets up on the receiver to output the main data. Set this to another value if the default stream is already used for another purpose.

SEP_YAW_OFFS.short: Heading/Yaw offset for dual antenna GPS.
SEP_YAW_OFFS.long: Heading offset angle for dual antenna GPS setups that support heading estimation. Set this to 0 if the antennas are parallel to the forward-facing direction of the vehicle and the rover antenna is in front. The offset angle increases clockwise. Set this to 90 if the rover antenna is placed on the right side of the vehicle and the moving base antenna is on the left side.

SIH_DISTSNSR_OVR.short: if >= 0 the distance sensor measures will be overridden by this value.
SIH_DISTSNSR_OVR.long: Absolute value superior to 10000 will disable distance sensor

SIH_IXX.long: The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_IXY.long: The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IXZ.long: The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IYY.long: The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_IYZ.long: The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. This value can be set to 0 for a quad symmetric about its center of mass.

SIH_IZZ.long: The inertia is a 3 by 3 symmetric matrix. It represents the difficulty of the vehicle to modify its angular rate.

SIH_KDV.long: Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particules. The greater this value, the slower the quad will move. Drag force function of velocity: D=-KDV*V. The maximum freefall velocity can be computed as V=10*MASS/KDV [m/s]

SIH_KDW.long: Physical coefficient representing the friction with air particules during rotations. The greater this value, the slower the quad will rotate. Aerodynamic moment function of body rate: Ma=-KDW*W_B. This value can be set to 0 if unknown.

SIH_LOC_H0.long: This value represents the Above Mean Sea Level (AMSL) altitude where the simulation begins. If using FlightGear as a visual animation, this value can be tweaked such that the vehicle lies on the ground at takeoff. LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_LAT0.long: This value represents the North-South location on Earth where the simulation begins. LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_LOC_LON0.long: This value represents the East-West location on Earth where the simulation begins. LAT0, LON0, H0, MU_X, MU_Y, and MU_Z should ideally be consistent among each others to represent a physical ground location on Earth.

SIH_L_PITCH.long: This is the arm length generating the pitching moment This value can be measured with a ruler. This corresponds to half the distance between the front and rear motors.

SIH_L_ROLL.long: This is the arm length generating the rolling moment This value can be measured with a ruler. This corresponds to half the distance between the left and right motors.

SIH_MASS.long: This value can be measured by weighting the quad on a scale.

SIH_Q_MAX.long: This is the maximum torque delivered by one propeller when the motor is running at full speed. This value is usually about few percent of the maximum thrust force.

SIH_T_MAX.long: This is the maximum force delivered by one propeller when the motor is running at full speed. This value is usually about 5 times the mass of the quadrotor.

SIH_T_TAU.long: the time taken for the thruster to step from 0 to 100% should be about 4 times tau

SIM_AGP_FAIL.long: Stuck: freeze the measurement to the current location Drift: add a linearly growing bias to the sensor data

SIM_GPS_USED.short: simulated GPS number of satellites used.

RPM_CAP_ENABLE.long: Enables the RPM capture module to estimate RPM from pulses detected on a PWM pin configured as "RPM Input".

RPM_PULS_PER_REV.long: Number of voltage pulses per one rotor revolution on the capturing pin.

SYS_AUTOCONFIG.long: Set to 1 to reset parameters on next system startup (setting defaults). Platform-specific values are used if available. RC* parameters are preserved.

SYS_AUTOSTART.long: CHANGING THIS VALUE REQUIRES A RESTART. Defines the auto-start script used to bootstrap the system.

SYS_BL_UPDATE.long: If enabled, update the bootloader on the next boot. WARNING: do not cut the power during an update process, otherwise you will have to recover using some alternative method (e.g. JTAG). Instructions: - Insert an SD card - Enable this parameter - Reboot the board (plug the power or send a reboot command) - Wait until the board comes back up (or at least 2 minutes) - If it does not come back, check the file bootlog.txt on the SD card

SYS_CAL_ACCEL.short: Enable auto start of accelerometer thermal calibration at the next power up.
SYS_CAL_ACCEL.long: 0 : Set to 0 to do nothing 1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts. default (0, no calibration)

SYS_CAL_BARO.short: Enable auto start of barometer thermal calibration at the next power up.
SYS_CAL_BARO.long: 0 : Set to 0 to do nothing 1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts. default (0, no calibration)

SYS_CAL_GYRO.short: Enable auto start of rate gyro thermal calibration at the next power up.
SYS_CAL_GYRO.long: 0 : Set to 0 to do nothing 1 : Set to 1 to start a calibration at next boot This parameter is reset to zero when the temperature calibration starts. default (0, no calibration)

SYS_CAL_TDEL.short: Required temperature rise during thermal calibration.
SYS_CAL_TDEL.long: A temperature increase greater than this value is required during calibration. Calibration will complete for each sensor when the temperature increase above the starting temperature exceeds the value set by SYS_CAL_TDEL. If the temperature rise is insufficient, the calibration will continue indefinitely and the board will need to be repowered to exit.

SYS_CAL_TMAX.short: Maximum starting temperature for thermal calibration.
SYS_CAL_TMAX.long: Temperature calibration will not start if the temperature of any sensor is higher than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMAX.

SYS_CAL_TMIN.short: Minimum starting temperature for thermal calibration.
SYS_CAL_TMIN.long: Temperature calibration for each sensor will ignore data if the temperature is lower than the value set by SYS_CAL_TMIN.

SYS_FAC_CAL_MODE.long: If enabled, future sensor calibrations will be stored to /fs/mtd_caldata. Note: this is only supported on boards with a separate calibration storage /fs/mtd_caldata.

SYS_FAILURE_EN.long: If enabled allows MAVLink INJECT_FAILURE commands. WARNING: the failures can easily cause crashes and are to be used with caution!

SYS_HAS_BARO.short: Control if the vehicle has a barometer.
SYS_HAS_BARO.long: Disable this if the board has no barometer, such as some of the Omnibus F4 SD variants. If disabled, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of a barometer.

SYS_HAS_GPS.short: Control if the vehicle has a GPS.
SYS_HAS_GPS.long: Disable this if the system has no GPS. If disabled, the sensors hub will not process sensor_gps, and GPS will not be available for the rest of the system.

SYS_HAS_MAG.short: Control if and how many magnetometers are expected.
SYS_HAS_MAG.long: 0: System has no magnetometer, preflight checks should pass without one. 1-N: Require the presence of N magnetometer sensors for check to pass.

SYS_HAS_NUM_ASPD.short: Control if the vehicle has an airspeed sensor.
SYS_HAS_NUM_ASPD.long: Set this to 0 if the board has no airspeed sensor. If set to 0, the preflight checks will not check for the presence of an airspeed sensor.

SYS_HAS_NUM_DIST.short: Number of distance sensors to check being available.
SYS_HAS_NUM_DIST.long: The preflight check will fail if fewer than this number of distance sensors with valid data is present. Disable the check with 0.

SYS_HAS_NUM_OF.short: Number of optical flow sensors required to be available.
SYS_HAS_NUM_OF.long: The preflight check will fail if fewer than this number of optical flow sensors with valid data are present.

SYS_HITL.short: Enable HITL/SIH mode on next boot.
SYS_HITL.long: While enabled the system will boot in Hardware-In-The-Loop (HITL) or Simulation-In-Hardware (SIH) mode and not enable all sensors and checks. When disabled the same vehicle can be flown normally. Set to 'external HITL', if the system should perform as if it were a real vehicle (the only difference to a real system is then only the parameter value, which can be used for log analysis).

SYS_PARAM_VER.long: This is used internally only: an airframe configuration might set an expected parameter version value via PARAM_DEFAULTS_VER. This is checked on bootup against SYS_PARAM_VER, and if they do not match, parameters are reset and reloaded from the airframe configuration.

SYS_RGB_MAXBRT.long: Set to 0 to disable, 1 for maximum brightness

TEL_FRSKY_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run FrSky Telemetry.

TEL_HOTT_CONFIG.long: Configure on which serial port to run HoTT Telemetry.

UAVCAN_ECU_FUELT.long: This parameter defines the type of fuel used in the vehicle's fuel tank. 0: Unknown 1: Liquid (e.g., gasoline, diesel) 2: Gas (e.g., hydrogen, methane, propane)

UAVCAN_ECU_MAXF.long: This parameter defines the maximum fuel capacity of the vehicle's fuel tank.

UAVCAN_ENABLE.long: 0 - UAVCAN disabled. 1 - Enables support for UAVCAN sensors without dynamic node ID allocation and firmware update. 2 - Enables support for UAVCAN sensors with dynamic node ID allocation and firmware update. 3 - Enables support for UAVCAN sensors and actuators with dynamic node ID allocation and firmware update. Also sets the motor control outputs to UAVCAN.

UAVCAN_LGT_ANTCL.long: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the ANTI_COLLISION lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_LGT_LAND.long: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the LIGHT_ID_LANDING lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_LGT_NAV.long: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the RIGHT_OF_WAY lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_LGT_STROB.long: This parameter defines the minimum condition under which the system will command the STROBE lights on 0 - Always off 1 - When autopilot is armed 2 - When autopilot is prearmed 3 - Always on

UAVCAN_NODE_ID.long: Read the specs at http://uavcan.org to learn more about Node ID.

UAVCAN_PUB_ARM.long: Enable UAVCAN Arming Status stream publication uavcan::equipment::safety::ArmingStatus

UAVCAN_PUB_MBD.short: publish moving baseline data RTCM stream.

UAVCAN_PUB_RTCM.long: Enable UAVCAN RTCM stream publication uavcan::equipment::gnss::RTCMStream

UAVCAN_RNG_MAX.long: This parameter defines the maximum valid range for a rangefinder connected via UAVCAN.

UAVCAN_RNG_MIN.long: This parameter defines the minimum valid range for a rangefinder connected via UAVCAN.

UAVCAN_SUB_BAT.long: Enable UAVCAN battery subscription. uavcan::equipment::power::BatteryInfo ardupilot::equipment::power::BatteryInfoAux 0 - Disable 1 - Use raw data. Recommended for Smart battery 2 - Filter the data with internal battery library

UAVCAN_SUB_DPRES.long: Enable UAVCAN differential pressure subscription. uavcan::equipment::air_data::RawAirData

UAVCAN_SUB_FUEL.long: Enable UAVCAN fuel tank status subscription.

UAVCAN_SUB_GPS.long: Enable UAVCAN GPS subscriptions. uavcan::equipment::gnss::Fix uavcan::equipment::gnss::Fix2 uavcan::equipment::gnss::Auxiliary

UAVCAN_SUB_GPS_R.long: Enable UAVCAN GPS Relative subscription. ardupilot::gnss::RelPosHeading

UAVCAN_SUB_ICE.long: Enable UAVCAN internal combustion engine (ICE) subscription. uavcan::equipment::ice::reciprocating::Status

UWB_SENS_ROT.long: The orientation of the sensor relative to the forward direction of the body frame. Look up table in src/lib/conversion/rotation.h Default position is the antannaes downward facing, UWB board parallel with body frame.

UXRCE_DDS_AG_IP.long: If ethernet is enabled and is the selected configuration for uXRCE-DDS, the selected Agent IP address will be set and used. Decimal dot notation is not supported. IP address must be provided in int32 format. For example, 192.168.1.2 is mapped to -1062731518; 127.0.0.1 is mapped to 2130706433.

UXRCE_DDS_CFG.long: Configure on which serial port to run UXRCE-DDS Client.

UXRCE_DDS_KEY.long: uXRCE-DDS key, must be different from zero. In a single agent - multi client configuration, each client must have a unique session key.

UXRCE_DDS_PRT.long: If ethernet is enabled and is the selected configuration for uXRCE-DDS, the selected UDP port will be set and used.

UXRCE_DDS_PTCFG.long: Set the participant configuration on the Agent's system. 0: Use the default configuration. 1: Restrict messages to localhost (use in combination with ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY=1). 2: Use a custom participant with the profile name "px4_participant".

UXRCE_DDS_RX_TO.long: Specifies after how many seconds without receiving data the DDS connection is reestablished. A value less than one disables the RX rate timeout.

UXRCE_DDS_SYNCC.long: When enabled along with UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT, uxrce_dds_client will set the system clock using the agents UTC timestamp.

UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT.long: When enabled, uxrce_dds_client will synchronize the timestamps of the incoming and outgoing messages measuring the offset between the Agent OS time and the PX4 time.

UXRCE_DDS_TX_TO.long: Specifies after how many seconds without sending data the DDS connection is reestablished. A value less than one disables the TX rate timeout.

VOXL2_IO_DIS.long: Pulse duration in disabled state (microseconds) for VOXL2_IO board

VT_ARSP_BLEND.long: Airspeed at which we can start blending both fw and mc controls. Set to 0 to disable.

VT_ARSP_TRANS.long: Airspeed at which we can switch to fw mode

VT_BT_TILT_DUR.short: Duration motor tilt up in backtransition.
VT_BT_TILT_DUR.long: Time in seconds it takes to tilt form VT_TILT_FW to VT_TILT_MC.

VT_B_DEC_I.short: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to pitch I gain.

VT_B_DEC_MSS.long: Used to calculate back transition distance in an auto mode. For standard vtol and tiltrotors a controller is used to track this value during the transition.

VT_B_TRANS_DUR.short: Maximum duration of a back transition.
VT_B_TRANS_DUR.long: Transition is also declared over if the groundspeed drops below MPC_XY_CRUISE.

VT_B_TRANS_RAMP.short: Back transition MC motor ramp up time.
VT_B_TRANS_RAMP.long: This sets the duration during which the MC motors ramp up to the commanded thrust during the back transition stage.

VT_ELEV_MC_LOCK.long: If set to 1 the control surfaces are locked at the disarmed value in multicopter mode.

VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.short: Use fixed-wing actuation in hover to accelerate forward.
VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.long: This feature can be used to avoid the plane having to pitch nose down in order to move forward. Prevents large, negative lift from pitching nose down into wind. Fixed-wing forward actuators refers to puller/pusher (standard VTOL), or forward-tilt (tiltrotor VTOL). Only active if demanded down pitch is below VT_PITCH_MIN. Use VT_FWD_THRUST_SC to tune it. Descend mode is treated as Landing too. Only active (if enabled) in Altitude, Position and Auto modes, not in Stabilized.

values.2: Enabled if distance to ground above MPC_LAND_ALT1
values.3: Enabled if distance to ground above MPC_LAND_ALT2
values.5: Enabled if distance to ground above MPC_LAND_ALT1 (except LANDING)
values.6: Enabled if distance to ground above MPC_LAND_ALT2 (except LANDING)

VT_FWD_THRUST_SC.short: Fixed-wing actuation thrust scale for hover forward flight.
VT_FWD_THRUST_SC.long: Scale applied to the demanded down-pitch to get the fixed-wing forward actuation in hover mode. Enabled via VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.long: Enable differential thrust seperately for roll, pitch, yaw in forward (fixed-wing) mode. The effectiveness of differential thrust around the corresponding axis can be tuned by setting VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P.short: Pitch differential thrust factor in forward flight.
VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P.long: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R.short: Roll differential thrust factor in forward flight.
VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R.long: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.short: Yaw differential thrust factor in forward flight.
VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.long: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

VT_FW_MIN_ALT.long: Minimum altitude for fixed-wing flight. When the vehicle is in fixed-wing mode and the altitude drops below this altitude (relative altitude above local origin), it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.

VT_FW_QC_HMAX.long: Maximum height above the ground (if available, otherwise above Home if available, otherwise above the local origin) where triggering a quad-chute is possible. At high altitudes there is a big risk to deplete the battery and therefore crash if quad-chuting there.

VT_FW_QC_P.long: Absolute pitch threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode. Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT. Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

VT_FW_QC_R.long: Absolute roll threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode. Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT. Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

VT_F_TRANS_DUR.long: Time in seconds used for a transition

VT_F_TRANS_THR.short: Target throttle value for the transition to fixed-wing flight.

VT_F_TR_OL_TM.long: The duration of the front transition when there is no airspeed feedback available. When airspeed is used, transition timeout is declared if airspeed does not reach VT_ARSP_BLEND after this time.

VT_LND_PITCH_MIN.short: Minimum pitch angle during hover landing.
VT_LND_PITCH_MIN.long: Overrides VT_PITCH_MIN when the vehicle is in LAND mode (hovering). During landing it can be beneficial to reduce the pitch angle to reduce the generated lift in head wind.

VT_PITCH_MIN.long: Any pitch setpoint below this value is translated to a forward force by the fixed-wing forward actuation if VT_FWD_TRHUST_EN is set.

VT_PSHER_SLEW.short: Pusher throttle ramp up slew rate.
VT_PSHER_SLEW.long: Defines the slew rate of the puller/pusher throttle during transitions. Zero will deactivate the slew rate limiting and thus produce an instant throttle rise to the transition throttle VT_F_TRANS_THR.

VT_QC_ALT_LOSS.long: Altitude error threshold for quad-chute triggering during fixed-wing flight. The check is only active if altitude is controlled and the vehicle is below the current altitude reference. The altitude error is relative to the highest altitude the vehicle has achieved since it has flown below the current altitude reference. Set to 0 do disable.

VT_QC_T_ALT_LOSS.long: Altitude loss threshold for quad-chute triggering during VTOL transition to fixed-wing flight in altitude-controlled flight modes. Active until 5s after completing transition to fixed-wing. If the current altitude is more than this value below the altitude at the beginning of the transition, it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT. Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

VT_TILT_TRANS.short: Normalized tilt in transition to FW.

VT_TRANS_MIN_TM.long: Minimum time in seconds for front transition.

VT_TRANS_P2_DUR.long: Time in seconds it takes to tilt form VT_TILT_TRANS to VT_TILT_FW.

VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT.long: Time in seconds after which transition will be cancelled.

WV_GAIN.long: The desired gain to convert roll sp into yaw rate sp.

VTO_LOITER_ALT.long: Altitude relative to home at which vehicle will loiter after front transition.

VERTIQ_IO_CFG.long: Configure on which serial port to run Vertiq IO.

VTQ_ARM_BEHAVE.short: The triggered behavior on PX4 arm.
VTQ_ARM_BEHAVE.long: The behavior triggered when the flight controller arms. You have the option to use your motors' arming behaviors, or to force all of your motors to arm

VTQ_BAUD.long: The baud rate (in bits per second) used by the serial port connected with IQUART communication

VTQ_CONTROL_MODE.short: Module Param - The module's control mechanism.
VTQ_CONTROL_MODE.long: PWM Mode: Commands a fraction of battery voltage. This changes as the battery voltage changes. This is the least safe mode because the upper throttle limit is determined by the battery voltage. Voltage Mode: Commands a voltage. The motor will behave the same way throughout the life of a battery, assuming the commanded voltage is less than the battery voltage. You must set the MAX_VOLTS parameter. Velocity Mode: Closed-loop, commands a velocity. The controller will adjust the applied voltage so that the motor spins at the commanded velocity. This mode has faster reaction times. Only use this if you know the properties of your propeller. You must set the MAX_VELOCITY parameter.

VTQ_DISARM_TRIG.short: The triggered behavior sent to the motors on PX4 disarm.
VTQ_DISARM_TRIG.long: The behavior triggered when the flight controller disarms. You have the option to trigger your motors' disarm behaviors, set all motors to coast, or set a predefined throttle setpoint

VTQ_DISARM_VELO.short: Velocity sent when DISARM_TRIGGER is Set Predefined Velocity Setpoint.
VTQ_DISARM_VELO.long: This is the velocity that will be sent to all motors when PX4 is disarmed and DISARM_TRIGGER is Set Predefined Velocity Setpoint

VTQ_FC_DIR.short: Module Param - If the flight controller uses 2D or 3D communication.
VTQ_FC_DIR.long: The FC and the ESC must agree upon the meaning of the signal coming out of the ESC. When FCs are in 3D mode they re-map negative signals. This parameter keeps the FC and ESC in agreement.

VTQ_MAX_VELOCITY.short: Module Param - Maximum velocity when CONTROL_MODE is set to Velocity.
VTQ_MAX_VELOCITY.long: Only relevant in Velocity Mode. This is the velocity the controller will command at full throttle.

VTQ_MAX_VOLTS.short: Module Param - Maximum voltage when CONTROL_MODE is set to Voltage.
VTQ_MAX_VOLTS.long: Only relevant in Voltage Mode. This is the voltage the controller will command at full throttle.

VTQ_MOTOR_DIR.short: Module Param - The direction that the module should spin.
VTQ_MOTOR_DIR.long: Set the targeted motor's spinning direction (clockwise vs. counter clockwise) and flight mode (2D non-reversible vs. 3D reversible)

VTQ_NUM_CVS.short: The number of Vertiq IFCI parameters to use.
VTQ_NUM_CVS.long: The total number of IFCI control variables being used across all connected modules

VTQ_PULSE_V_LIM.short: Module Param - Max pulsing voltage limit when in Voltage Limit Mode.
VTQ_PULSE_V_LIM.long: This sets the max pulsing voltage limit when in Voltage Limit Mode.

VTQ_PULSE_V_MODE.short: Module Param - 0 = Supply Voltage Mode, 1 = Voltage Limit Mode.
VTQ_PULSE_V_MODE.long: Supply Voltage Mode means that the maximum voltage applied to pulsing is the supplied voltage. Voltage Limit Mode indicates that PULSE_VOLT_LIM is the maximum allowed voltage to apply towards pulsing.

VTQ_REDO_READ.short: Reinitialize the target module's values into the PX4 parameters.
VTQ_REDO_READ.long: Setting this value to true will reinitialize PX4's IQUART connected parameters to the value stored on the currently targeted motor. This is especially useful if your flight controller powered on before your connected modules

VTQ_TELEM_IDS_1.short: Module IDs [0, 31] that you would like to request telemetry from.
VTQ_TELEM_IDS_1.long: The module IDs [0, 31] that should be asked for telemetry. The data received from these IDs will be published via the esc_status topic.

VTQ_TELEM_IDS_2.short: Module IDs [32, 62] that you would like to request telemetry from.
VTQ_TELEM_IDS_2.long: The module IDs [32, 62] that should be asked for telemetry. The data received from these IDs will be published via the esc_status topic.

VTQ_THROTTLE_CVI.short: Module Param - The module's Throttle Control Value Index.
VTQ_THROTTLE_CVI.long: This represents the Control Value Index where the targeted module will look for throttle commands

VTQ_TQUE_OFF_ANG.short: Module Param - Offsets pulse angle to allow for mechanical properties.
VTQ_TQUE_OFF_ANG.long: This offsets where the pulse starts around the motor to allow for propeller mechanical properties.

VTQ_TRGT_MOD_ID.short: The Module ID of the module you would like to communicate with.
VTQ_TRGT_MOD_ID.long: This is the value used as the target module ID of all configuration parameters (not operational parameters). The Vertiq module with the module ID matching this value will react to all get and set requests from PX4. Any Vertiq client made with dynamic object IDs should use this value to instantiate itself.

VTQ_VELO_CUTOFF.short: Module Param - The minimum velocity required to allow pulsing.
VTQ_VELO_CUTOFF.long: This is the velocity at which pulsing is allowed. Any velocity between VELOCITY_CUTOFF and -VELOCITY_CUTOFF will not pulse.

VTQ_X_CVI.short: Module Param - CVI for the X rectangular coordinate.
VTQ_X_CVI.long: This represents the Control Value Index where the targeted module will look for the X rectangular coordinate.

VTQ_Y_CVI.short: Module Param - CVI for the Y rectangular coordinate.
VTQ_Y_CVI.long: This represents the Control Value Index where the targeted module will look for the Y rectangular coordinate.

VTQ_ZERO_ANGLE.short: Module Param - The encoder angle at which theta is zero.
VTQ_ZERO_ANGLE.long: The encoder angle at which theta is zero. Adjust this number to change the location of 0 phase when pulsing.

values.2: Enabled in VTOL MC mode, listen to request from system in FW mode

values.1: skip the controller and feedthrough the setpoints
